1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# spend.sh — cycle-130 cycle spend (SDD §5.11, PRD FR-2, DEC-0363)
     4	#
     5	# Prints what the cycle has spent: the run rows' cost_usd plus the operator
     6	# cost ledger's cost_micro_usd since the kickoff timestamp, against the cap.
     7	#
     8	# Usage:
     9	#   spend.sh [--since TS] [--runs FILE…] [--ledger FILE] [--cap USD]
    10	#            [--reserve USD] [--json]
    11	#
    12	#   --since TS     ledger rows with ts >= TS count (default 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z,
    13	#                  the cycle-130 kickoff); run rows are the cycle's own and all count
    14	#   --runs FILE…   run-row files (JSONL, `cost_usd` per row); repeatable, and every
    15	#                  following non-option argument is a file too. Default:
    16	#                  grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl plus every
    17	#                  evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl that exists. A row whose
    18	#                  run_id was already counted from another file is counted once.
    19	#   --ledger FILE  cost ledger (JSONL, `ts`, `cost_micro_usd`; default .run/cost-ledger.jsonl)
    20	#   --cap USD      cycle cap (default: evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
    21	#                  else caps.cycle_usd in evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml, else 1500)
    22	#   --reserve USD  reserve (default caps.reserve_usd in the suite file, else 250)
    23	#   --json         one JSON object: total_usd, runs_usd, ledger_usd, since, cap_usd,
    24	#                  headroom_usd, reserve_usd, runs_files, ledger_file, runs_rows,
    25	#                  runs_rows_deduped, ledger_rows, skipped_lines
    26	#
    27	# Output: cycle spend USD T (runs R + ledger L since S); cap C; headroom H; reserve V
    28	#   headroom = cap - total (negative when over). Default files that do not exist
    29	#   count as zero; a malformed line is skipped and counted (stderr note).
    30	#
    31	# Exit: 0 printed; 1 a named file (or an existing default) is unreadable; 2 usage.
    32	# Tested by evals/tests/spend.bats.
    33	# =============================================================================
    34	set -euo pipefail
    35	export LC_ALL=C
    36	
    37	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    38	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    39	SINCE="2026-10-14T13:50:00Z"
    40	LEDGER="" CAP="" RESERVE="" JSON=false
    41	RUNS=()
    42	
    43	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,32p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    44	die() { echo "spend: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    45	num_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; }
    46	
    47	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    48	  case "$1" in
    49	    --since) SINCE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    50	    --runs)
    51	      [[ -n "${2:-}" && "${2:-}" != --* ]] || die "--runs needs at least one file"
    52	      shift
    53	      while [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" != --* ]]; do RUNS+=("$1"); shift; done ;;
    54	    --ledger) LEDGER="${2:-}"; [[ -n "$LEDGER" ]] || die "--ledger needs a file"; shift 2 ;;
    55	    --cap) CAP="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    56	    --reserve) RESERVE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    57	    --json) JSON=true; shift ;;
    58	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    59	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    60	  esac
    61	done
    62	[[ "$SINCE" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})?)?$ ]] \
    63	  || die "--since must be an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z)"
    64	command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: python3"
    65	
    66	SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    67	yq_num() {  # yq_num <expr> <file> — a number or empty
    68	  local v
    69	  [[ -f "$2" ]] && command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
    70	  v="$(yq -r "$1 // \"\"" "$2" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    71	  num_ok "$v" && printf '%s' "$v"
    72	  return 0
    73	}
    74	if [[ -z "$CAP" ]]; then
    75	  CAP="$(yq_num '.evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml")"
    76	  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP="$(yq_num '.caps.cycle_usd' "$SUITE")"
    77	  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP=1500
    78	fi
    79	if [[ -z "$RESERVE" ]]; then
    80	  RESERVE="$(yq_num '.caps.reserve_usd' "$SUITE")"
    81	  [[ -n "$RESERVE" ]] || RESERVE=250
    82	fi
    83	num_ok "$CAP" || die "--cap must be a non-negative number"
    84	num_ok "$RESERVE" || die "--reserve must be a non-negative number"
    85	
    86	# Explicit files must be readable; defaults are optional (absent = zero).
    87	if [[ ${#RUNS[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    88	  [[ -e "$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl" ]] && RUNS+=("$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl")
    89	  for f in "$REPO_ROOT"/evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl; do [[ -e "$f" ]] && RUNS+=("$f"); done
    90	fi
    91	EXPLICIT_LEDGER=true

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)
     4	#
     5	# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
     9	#
    10	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
    11	#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
    12	#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
    13	#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
    14	#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
    15	#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
    16	#
    17	# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
    18	#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
    19	#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
    20	#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?}, post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
    21	#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
    22	#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
    23	#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
    24	#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
    25	#      relative paths present in the fixture), structural_check (hidden/… | null;
    26	#      required for refactor), bounds {max_turns{}, timeout_min{}} (phase → positive
    27	#      int), review_catch (null, or {fixture, manifest, labels?} for review-catch,
    28	#      both present), suite_version (= the suite file's), TASK.md present
    29	#   2. counts: four tasks of each type under tasks/ (unless --allow-partial)
    30	#   3. allowlist: test_command[0] and regression_command[0] in python3 | pytest |
    31	#      bats | bash | node | npx
    32	#   4. hidden/manifest.json (build types): {"files": [{src, dest}]}; every src
    33	#      exists under hidden/; every dest is relative, inside the tree, no `..`
    34	#   5. fixture path rule (build types): check_fixture_path_rule from
    35	#      lib/sandbox-mount.sh — no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires/
    36	#      or .run/ at the fixture's top level; the reference patch touches none either
    37	#   6. leakage: TASK.md and criterion (the task-brief text is built from these)
    38	#      and every phase prompt under evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts/ contain none
    39	#      of: the string `hidden` (any case), a hidden test file's stem, a defect id
    40	#      of the review manifest, a `D[0-9]{2}-` key, an arm id of the suite file
    41	#   7. suite file: every non-absent arm's task_types are known (all | build |
    42	#      review-catch | feature-build | bug-fix | refactor)
    43	#
    44	# Exit: 0 valid; 1 violations (every one listed); 2 usage / unreadable input.
    45	# Tested by evals/tests/validate-suite.bats.
    46	# =============================================================================
    47	set -euo pipefail
    48	export LC_ALL=C
    49	
    50	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    51	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    52	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    53	SUITE_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    54	PROMPTS_DIR="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts}"
    55	SMOKE=false ALLOW_PARTIAL=false
    56	
    57	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,45p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    58	die() { echo "validate-suite: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    59	
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    63	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; shift ;;
    64	    --allow-partial) ALLOW_PARTIAL=true; shift ;;
    65	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    66	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    67	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    68	  esac
    69	done
    70	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
    71	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    72	[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
    73	for tool in yq jq python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: $tool"; done
    74	# eval.yml trust boundary: a literal in-tree path, no variable on the source line
    75	pushd "$SCRIPT_DIR" >/dev/null
    76	# shellcheck source=lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    77	source ./lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    78	popd >/dev/null
    79	
    80	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/validate-suite.XXXXXX")"
    81	trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
    82	yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE" > "$WORK/suite.json" 2>/dev/null || die "suite file is not valid YAML: $SUITE_FILE"
    83	
    84	# Collect task directories: tasks/* (counted) and smoke/* (with --smoke).
    85	: > "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
    86	for group in tasks smoke; do
    87	  [[ "$group" == "smoke" && "$SMOKE" != "true" ]] && continue
    88	  [[ -d "$ROOT/$group" ]] || continue
    89	  for d in "$ROOT/$group"/*/; do
    90	    [[ -d "$d" ]] || continue
    91	    d="${d%/}"
    92	    n="$(basename "$d")"
    93	    j="$WORK/$group.$n.json"
    94	    if [[ ! -f "$d/task.yaml" ]]; then
    95	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "-" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"; continue
    96	    fi
    97	    if yq -o=json '.' "$d/task.yaml" > "$j" 2>/dev/null && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$j" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    98	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "$j" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
    99	    else
   100	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "!" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
   101	    fi
   102	  done
   103	done
   104	
   105	# Python does the schema, counts, allowlist, manifest, leakage and suite checks;
   106	# it prints violations, and `FIXTURE\t<id>\t<dir>` lines for the path rule below.
   107	python3 -I - "$WORK/tasks.tsv" "$WORK/suite.json" "$ROOT" "$REPO_ROOT" "$ALLOW_PARTIAL" "$PROMPTS_DIR" > "$WORK/out.txt" <<'PY' || { cat "$WORK/out.txt" >&2 2>/dev/null; die "validator crashed"; }
   108	import json, os, re, sys
   109	
   110	tasks_tsv, suite_json, root, repo, allow_partial, prompts_dir = sys.argv[1:7]
   111	allow_partial = allow_partial == "true"
   112	suite = json.load(open(suite_json))
   113	out = []
   114	def bad(tid, msg): out.append(f"{tid}: {msg}")
   115	
   116	TYPES = ["feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor", "review-catch"]
   117	BUILD = {"feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor"}
   118	ALLOW = {"python3", "pytest", "bats", "bash", "node", "npx"}
   119	KNOWN_TASK_TYPES = {"all", "build", "review-catch", "feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor"}
   120	MOUNT_OWNED = (".claude", "CLAUDE.md", ".loa.config.yaml", "grimoires", ".run")
   121	REQUIRED = ["id", "schema_version", "type", "source", "post_cutoff", "fixture", "criterion",
   122	            "success_criterion", "test_command", "regression_command", "reference_patch",
   123	            "grader_protected", "structural_check", "bounds", "review_catch", "suite_version"]
   124	
   125	arms = [a for a in (suite.get("arms") or []) if isinstance(a, dict)]
   126	arm_ids = sorted({a.get("id") for a in arms if isinstance(a.get("id"), str)})
   127	for a in arms:
   128	    if a.get("absent") is True:
   129	        continue
   130	    tt = a.get("task_types")
   131	    if not isinstance(tt, list) or not tt:
   132	        bad("suite", f"arm {a.get('id')} has no task_types list")
   133	        continue
   134	    for t in tt:
   135	        if t not in KNOWN_TASK_TYPES:
   136	            bad("suite", f"arm {a.get('id')} task_types names unknown type '{t}'")
   137	suite_version = suite.get("suite_version")
   138	
   139	def rel_ok(p):
   140	    return isinstance(p, str) and p and not p.startswith("/") and ".." not in p.split("/") and "\\" not in p
   141	
   142	def is_str_list(v):
   143	    return isinstance(v, list) and all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in v)
   144	
   145	def read(p):
   146	    try:
   147	        return open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
   148	    except OSError:
   149	        return None
   150	
   151	prompt_texts = []
   152	if os.path.isdir(prompts_dir):
   153	    for f in sorted(os.listdir(prompts_dir)):
   154	        if f.endswith(".md"):
   155	            prompt_texts.append((f"phase-prompts/{f}", read(os.path.join(prompts_dir, f)) or ""))
   156	
   157	def leak_scan(tid, label, text, stems, defect_ids):
   158	    low = text.lower()
   159	    if "hidden" in low:
   160	        bad(tid, f"leak: {label} contains the string 'hidden'")
   161	    for s in stems:
   162	        if s and re.search(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])" + re.escape(s.lower()) + r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_])", low):
   163	            bad(tid, f"leak: {label} names the grader file stem '{s}'")
   164	    for d in defect_ids:
   165	        if d in text:
   166	            bad(tid, f"leak: {label} names defect id '{d}'")
   167	    m = re.search(r"\bD[0-9]{2}-", text)
   168	    if m:
   169	        bad(tid, f"leak: {label} carries a defect key pattern '{m.group(0)}'")
   170	    for a in arm_ids:
   171	        if re.search(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])" + re.escape(a) + r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_])", text):
   172	            bad(tid, f"leak: {label} names arm id '{a}'")
   173	
   174	counts = {t: 0 for t in TYPES}
   175	seen = {}
   176	for line in open(tasks_tsv, encoding="utf-8"):
   177	    line = line.rstrip("\n")
   178	    if not line:
   179	        continue
   180	    group, name, tdir, jpath = line.split("\t")
   181	    tid = f"{group}/{name}"
   182	    if jpath == "-":
   183	        bad(tid, "no task.yaml"); continue
   184	    if jpath == "!":
   185	        bad(tid, "task.yaml is not a YAML mapping"); continue
   186	    t = json.load(open(jpath))
   187	    for k in REQUIRED:
   188	        if k not in t:
   189	            bad(tid, f"schema: missing field '{k}'")
   190	    if t.get("id") != name:
   191	        bad(tid, f"schema: id '{t.get('id')}' differs from the directory name")
   192	    if not isinstance(t.get("id"), str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}", t.get("id") or ""):
   193	        bad(tid, "schema: id must match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}")
   194	    elif t["id"] in seen:
   195	        bad(tid, f"schema: duplicate id (also {seen[t['id']]})")
   196	    else:
   197	        seen[t["id"]] = tid
   198	    if t.get("schema_version") != 1:
   199	        bad(tid, "schema: schema_version must be 1")
   200	    ttype = t.get("type")
   201	    if ttype not in TYPES:
   202	        bad(tid, f"schema: type '{ttype}' not in {'|'.join(TYPES)}")
   203	    elif group == "tasks":
   204	        counts[ttype] += 1
   205	    src = t.get("source")
   206	    if not isinstance(src, dict):
   207	        bad(tid, "schema: source must be a mapping")
   208	    else:
   209	        if not isinstance(src.get("kind"), str) or not src.get("kind"):
   210	            bad(tid, "schema: source.kind must be a non-empty string")
   211	        if not isinstance(src.get("date"), str) or not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", src.get("date") or ""):
   212	            bad(tid, "schema: source.date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
   213	        for k in ("fix_commit", "base_commit"):
   214	            if k in src and src[k] is not None and not (isinstance(src[k], str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{7,40}", src[k])):
   215	                bad(tid, f"schema: source.{k} must be a hex commit id")
   216	        for k in src:
   217	            if k not in ("kind", "date", "fix_commit", "base_commit", "bead", "origin"):
   218	                bad(tid, f"schema: source.{k} is not a known key")
   219	    if not isinstance(t.get("post_cutoff"), bool):
   220	        bad(tid, "schema: post_cutoff must be a boolean")
   221	    build = ttype in BUILD
   222	    fx = t.get("fixture")
   223	    fixture_dir = None
   224	    if fx is None:
   225	        if build:
   226	            bad(tid, "schema: fixture is required for build types")
   227	    elif not rel_ok(fx):
   228	        bad(tid, "schema: fixture must be a relative path inside the root")
   229	    elif not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(root, fx)):
   230	        bad(tid, f"schema: fixture directory not found: {fx}")
   231	    else:
   232	        fixture_dir = os.path.join(root, fx)
   233	        if build:
   234	            print(f"FIXTURE\t{tid}\t{fixture_dir}")
   235	    crit = t.get("criterion")
   236	    if not isinstance(crit, str) or not crit.strip():
   237	        bad(tid, "schema: criterion must be a non-empty string")
   238	        crit = ""
   239	    else:
   240	        if "/" in crit or re.search(r"\b[\w.-]+\.(py|sh|bats|js|ts|mjs|json|ya?ml|md|toml|cfg|ini|txt|patch)\b", crit):
   241	            bad(tid, "schema: criterion names a path or file (agent-facing behaviour only)")
   242	        if re.search(r"\btest_\w+", crit):
   243	            bad(tid, "schema: criterion names a test")
   244	    if not isinstance(t.get("success_criterion"), str) or not t.get("success_criterion", "").strip():
   245	        bad(tid, "schema: success_criterion must be a non-empty string")
   246	    for key in ("test_command", "regression_command"):
   247	        v = t.get(key)
   248	        if v is None:
   249	            if key == "test_command" and ttype != "review-catch":
   250	                bad(tid, "schema: test_command is required for build types")
   251	            continue
   252	        if not is_str_list(v) or not v:
   253	            bad(tid, f"schema: {key} must be a non-empty array of strings or null")
   254	        elif v[0] not in ALLOW:
   255	            bad(tid, f"allowlist: {key}[0] '{v[0]}' not in {'|'.join(sorted(ALLOW))}")
   256	    for key, must in (("reference_patch", ttype in ("bug-fix", "feature-build")), ("structural_check", ttype == "refactor")):
   257	        v = t.get(key)
   258	        if v is None:
   259	            if must:
   260	                bad(tid, f"schema: {key} is required for {ttype}")
   261	            continue
   262	        if not rel_ok(v) or not v.startswith("hidden/"):
   263	            bad(tid, f"schema: {key} must be a relative path under hidden/")
   264	        elif not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(tdir, v)):
   265	            bad(tid, f"schema: {key} not found: {v}")
   266	    gp = t.get("grader_protected")
   267	    if not isinstance(gp, list) or not all(isinstance(x, str) for x in gp):
   268	        bad(tid, "schema: grader_protected must be an array of paths")
   269	    else:
   270	        for p in gp:
   271	            if not rel_ok(p):
   272	                bad(tid, f"schema: grader_protected path '{p}' is not a relative path inside the tree")
   273	            elif fixture_dir and not os.path.exists(os.path.join(fixture_dir, p)):
   274	                bad(tid, f"schema: grader_protected path '{p}' is not in the fixture")
   275	    bounds = t.get("bounds")
   276	    if not isinstance(bounds, dict) or set(bounds) != {"max_turns", "timeout_min"}:
   277	        bad(tid, "schema: bounds must be {max_turns: {}, timeout_min: {}}")
   278	    else:
   279	        for k in ("max_turns", "timeout_min"):
   280	            m = bounds[k]
   281	            if not isinstance(m, dict) or not all(isinstance(x, int) and not isinstance(x, bool) and x > 0 for x in m.values()):
   282	                bad(tid, f"schema: bounds.{k} must map phases to positive integers")
   283	            elif any(p not in ("PLAN", "IMPLEMENT", "REVIEW", "FIX", "AUDIT", "BARE") for p in m):
   284	                bad(tid, f"schema: bounds.{k} names an unknown phase")
   285	    rc = t.get("review_catch")
   286	    defect_ids = []
   287	    if ttype == "review-catch":
   288	        if not isinstance(rc, dict):
   289	            bad(tid, "schema: review_catch {fixture, manifest} is required for review-catch")
   290	        else:
   291	            for k in rc:
   292	                if k not in ("fixture", "manifest", "labels"):
   293	                    bad(tid, f"schema: review_catch.{k} is not a known key")
   294	            rf, rm = rc.get("fixture"), rc.get("manifest")
   295	            if not rel_ok(rf) or not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(repo, "evals", "fixtures", rf)):
   296	                bad(tid, f"schema: review_catch.fixture not found under evals/fixtures: {rf}")
   297	            if not rel_ok(rm) or not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(repo, rm)):
   298	                bad(tid, f"schema: review_catch.manifest not found: {rm}")
   299	            else:
   300	                try:
   301	                    defect_ids = [d.get("id") for d in json.load(open(os.path.join(repo, rm))).get("defects", []) if d.get("id")]
   302	                except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError):
   303	                    bad(tid, f"schema: review_catch.manifest is not a defect manifest: {rm}")
   304	    elif rc is not None:
   305	        bad(tid, "schema: review_catch must be null for build types")
   306	    sv = t.get("suite_version")
   307	    if not isinstance(sv, int) or isinstance(sv, bool) or sv < 1:
   308	        bad(tid, "schema: suite_version must be a positive integer")
   309	    elif suite_version is not None and sv != suite_version:
   310	        bad(tid, f"schema: suite_version {sv} differs from the suite file's {suite_version}")
   311	
   312	    stems = []
   313	    hm = os.path.join(tdir, "hidden", "manifest.json")
   314	    if build:
   315	        if not os.path.isfile(hm):
   316	            bad(tid, "hidden: hidden/manifest.json is missing")
   317	        else:
   318	            try:
   319	                files = json.load(open(hm)).get("files")
   320	            except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError):
   321	                files = None
   322	            if not isinstance(files, list) or not files:
   323	                bad(tid, "hidden: manifest.json must be {\"files\": [{src, dest}, ...]}")
   324	            else:
   325	                for e in files:
   326	                    s_, d_ = (e or {}).get("src"), (e or {}).get("dest")
   327	                    if not rel_ok(s_) or not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(tdir, "hidden", s_)):
   328	                        bad(tid, f"hidden: manifest src not found under hidden/: {s_}")
   329	                    if not rel_ok(d_):
   330	                        bad(tid, f"hidden: manifest dest must be a relative path inside the tree: {d_}")
   331	                    elif d_.split("/")[0] in MOUNT_OWNED:
   332	                        bad(tid, f"hidden: manifest dest lands on a mount-owned path: {d_}")
   333	                    if isinstance(s_, str) and s_:
   334	                        stems.append(os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(s_))[0])
   335	        sc = t.get("structural_check")
   336	        if isinstance(sc, str) and sc:
   337	            stems.append(os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(sc))[0])
   338	        rp = t.get("reference_patch")
   339	        if isinstance(rp, str) and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(tdir, rp)):
   340	            for pl in (read(os.path.join(tdir, rp)) or "").splitlines():
   341	                m = re.match(r"^(?:\+\+\+|---) (?:[ab]/)?(\S+)", pl)
   342	                if m and m.group(1) != "/dev/null" and m.group(1).split("/")[0] in MOUNT_OWNED:
   343	                    bad(tid, f"fixture path rule: reference patch touches a mount-owned path: {m.group(1)}")
   344	    task_md = read(os.path.join(tdir, "TASK.md"))
   345	    if task_md is None:
   346	        bad(tid, "schema: TASK.md is missing")
   347	        task_md = ""
   348	    leak_scan(tid, "TASK.md", task_md, stems, defect_ids)
   349	    leak_scan(tid, "criterion", crit, stems, defect_ids)
   350	    for label, text in prompt_texts:
   351	        leak_scan(tid, label, text, stems, defect_ids)
   352	
   353	if not allow_partial:
   354	    for ty in TYPES:
   355	        if counts[ty] != 4:
   356	            bad("suite", f"counts: {counts[ty]} {ty} task(s) under tasks/, want 4 (pass --allow-partial before the freeze)")
   357	
   358	for o in out:
   359	    print(o)
   360	PY
   361	
   362	violations=0
   363	: > "$WORK/report.txt"
   364	while IFS= read -r line; do
   365	  if [[ "$line" == FIXTURE$'\t'* ]]; then
   366	    IFS=$'\t' read -r _ tid fdir <<<"$line"
   367	    if ! check_fixture_path_rule "$fdir" 2>"$WORK/rule.err"; then
   368	      printf '%s: fixture path rule: %s\n' "$tid" "$(tr '\n' ' ' < "$WORK/rule.err" | sed 's/ *$//')" >> "$WORK/report.txt"
   369	    fi
   370	  else
   371	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$WORK/report.txt"
   372	  fi
   373	done < "$WORK/out.txt"
   374	violations="$(grep -c . "$WORK/report.txt" || true)"
   375	ntasks="$(grep -c . "$WORK/tasks.tsv" || true)"
   376	if [[ "$violations" -gt 0 ]]; then
   377	  cat "$WORK/report.txt"
   378	  echo "validate-suite: $violations violation(s) over $ntasks task(s) in $ROOT" >&2
   379	  exit 1
   380	fi
   381	echo "validate-suite: OK — $ntasks task(s) valid in $ROOT$([[ "$ALLOW_PARTIAL" == "true" ]] && echo " (partial: type counts not enforced)")"
   382	exit 0

1	# =============================================================================
     2	# evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml — cycle-130 Loa 2.0 component ablation suite
     3	#
     4	# SDD §3.3 (structure reproduced), extended by Sprint 258 Task 1.6: the
     5	# tasks block with the smoke root, phase_defaults, phase_sets, cost_hint, each
     6	# arm's phase-set override and took-effect rule ids, and the full pre-registered
     7	# rules block (D-A5; mirrored in NOTES before the first run, DEC-0383).
     8	#
     9	# Readers: execute-agent.sh / lib/sandbox-mount.sh (arms[].toggles via
    10	# resolve_arm_toggles), pipeline-run.sh (phase_defaults, phase_sets,
    11	# arms[].phases, arms[].effort), took-effect.sh (arms[].took_effect),
    12	# run-ablation.sh (trials, caps, priority, cut_ladder, arms[].task_types),
    13	# ablation-report.py (rules), validate-suite.sh (arm ids for the leakage check,
    14	# task_types against the known types).
    15	#
    16	# task_types: `all` | `build` (= feature-build, bug-fix, refactor) |
    17	#   `review-catch` | a single build type. An arm is never scheduled, and a row
    18	#   never reported, on a type outside its declaration (DEC-0400, DEC-0406).
    19	# took_effect: rule ids took-effect.sh evaluates per trial (DEC-0418); a miss is
    20	#   infrastructure_error and pauses the arm. `applicability_refused` is the
    21	#   smoke's evidence line that the planner refused the arm on a review-catch task.
    22	# =============================================================================
    23	name: ablation-2.0
    24	version: 1
    25	source_commit: "<sprint-258-commit>"   # the lead sets the Sprint 258 commit (rc.5 plus the mount fix; F2, DEC-0392)
    26	agy_opt_in: false
    27	tasks:
    28	  root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/tasks
    29	  manifest: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/MANIFEST.sha256

    31	suite_version: 1
    32	trials: {build: 3, review-catch: 3}      # D-A4: review-catch trials 3, not 5, under the gate pipeline
    33	cut_ladder: ["A5, A6, A7 not run", "A2 and A3 build trials 3 -> 2", "A3 review-catch trials 3 -> 2"]   # DEC-0397; A0, A1, A4 keep 3
    34	caps: {cycle_usd: 1500, run_usd: 12, reserve_usd: 250}   # reserve released to A7 when the re-verification rule needs no run (DEC-0398)
    35	priority: [a0_bare, a1_full, a2_no_sprint_plan, a3_one_voice, a4_no_gates, a7_effort_medium, a5_no_flatline, a6_one_window]
    36	cost_hint: {build: 7, review-catch: 8}   # USD per run before any actual exists (run-arms/run-ablation est_next fallback)
    37	
    38	# Session defaults per phase (SDD D-4.3). A6's continued session carries the
    39	# caps of the phase it is in; A0's BARE caps are PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX.
    40	phase_defaults:
    41	  models:
    42	    PLAN: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    43	    IMPLEMENT: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    44	    FIX: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    45	    BARE: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    46	    REVIEW: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
    47	    AUDIT: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
    48	  # REVIEW/AUDIT 60 turns / 30 min: the Sprint 258 smoke saw a review-catch AUDIT hit 40 turns after writing its
    49	  # verdict (DEC-0490); BARE stays the implementer-side sum (PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX)
    50	  max_turns: {PLAN: 30, IMPLEMENT: 60, REVIEW: 60, FIX: 40, AUDIT: 60, BARE: 170}
    51	  timeout_min: {PLAN: 15, IMPLEMENT: 25, REVIEW: 30, FIX: 15, AUDIT: 30, BARE: 70}
    52	  tools: "Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"   # identical for every arm, A0 included
    53	phase_sets:   # D-4.1: A1's phases per task type; FIX runs only after a CHANGES_REQUIRED gate
    54	  review-catch: [REVIEW, AUDIT]

    56	
    57	arms:

    59	     took_effect: [no_dot_claude, no_system_prompt, no_audit_rows, integrity_clean]}
    60	  - {id: a1_full, label: A1, task_types: [all], toggles: {}, took_effect: [all_phases_present, integrity_clean]}
    61	  - {id: a2_no_sprint_plan, label: A2, task_types: [build], toggles: {sprint_plan: false},
    62	     phases: [IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX],
    63	     took_effect: [no_plan_phase, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
    64	  - {id: a3_one_voice, label: A3, task_types: [all], toggles: {companion_voice: false}, took_effect: [one_voice_planned, integrity_clean]}
    65	  - {id: a4_no_gates, label: A4, task_types: [build], toggles: {gates: false},
    66	     phases: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT],
    67	     took_effect: [no_gate_phases, enforce_env_false, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}   # build only: on a review-catch task the gates are the task (DEC-0400)
    68	  - {id: a5_no_flatline, label: A5, task_types: [build], toggles: {flatline: false},
    69	     took_effect: [no_flatline_rows, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh — sandbox materialisation and arm toggles
4	#
5	# cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.6 (SDD D-4.5, DEC-0421, DEC-0423, DEC-0396).
6	# Extracted from execute-agent.sh (cycle-129 step 2 and the toggle functions)
7	# WITHOUT behaviour change for the cycle-129 single-skill path, and shared with
8	# pipeline-run.sh. Source it; it defines functions only and sets no shell
9	# options (the caller runs under `set -euo pipefail`).
10	#
11	# Contract (every function returns 0 on success, 2 when refused / when a step
12	# cannot take effect; refusals name the reason on one stderr line):
13	#
14	#   mount_prompt_surface <ws> <prompt_tree> <skill|->
15	#       skill given: <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/ (whole dir), .claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md,
16	#       .claude/rules/, CLAUDE.md = "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"; the prompt tree's
17	#       .loa.config.yaml only in arm mode (LOA_EVAL_ARM set), as cycle-129 did.
18	#       skill "-": the whole .claude/ tree is copied (files, never a symlink to the
19	#       tree), CLAUDE.md as above, and .loa.config.yaml always (the pipeline
20	#       executor needs every skill, hook and script). Evidence: mount=skill:<s>|tree.
21	#   resolve_arm_toggles <arm> <suite_file>
22	#       prints the arm's toggles as compact JSON on stdout. Arms are read from
23	#       `.arms[]` (ablation-2.0) and `.ab.arms[]` (recall suites). An arm with
24	#       toggles {} (a1_full, baseline) prints {}; `baseline` undeclared prints {}.
25	#       Exit 2: undeclared arm (an unreadable suite file declares none), `absent: true` arm.
26	#   apply_arm_toggles <ws> <toggles_json> <arm>
27	#       applies every toggle to the SANDBOX COPY and verifies it afterwards; exit 2
28	#       when one cannot take effect or is unknown. Toggles and values:
29	#         companion_voice: false  flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
30	#         karpathy_block: false   '## Karpathy Principles' out of CLAUDE.loa.md (+ constraints.json rows)
31	#         rule_files: false       stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of .claude/rules/
32	#         audit_delta_instruction: false  the delta paragraph out of auditing-security/SKILL.md
33	#         loa_mount: false        verifies no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml in <ws>
34	#                                 (the caller skips mount_prompt_surface); evidence loa_mount=none
35	#         effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max
36	#                                 every `effort:` line out of the frontmatter of every
37	#                                 <ws>/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; every `default_effort` key in
38	#                                 <ws>/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml set to the value and its
39	#                                 .checksum (bare sha256 hex) refreshed when present.
40	#                                 The caller passes `--effort <v>` on argv.
41	#         gates: false            flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false;
42	#                                 LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false exported in the CALLING shell
43	#                                 and written to $ARM_ENV_FILE (KEY=VALUE lines) when that is set
44	#         flatline: false         flatline_protocol.enabled=false
45	#         sprint_plan: false, context_resets: false
46	#                                 phase-set edits owned by the pipeline executor; recorded as
47	#                                 evidence here (the single-skill executor refuses them itself)
48	#   regen_sandbox_manifest <ws>
49	#       writes <ws>/.claude/checksums.json {generated, algorithm: sha256, files} over
50	#       every regular file under <ws>/.claude except overrides/ and the manifest
51	#       itself (LC_ALL=C order, sha256). tools/gen-checksums.sh (in the
52	#       prompt tree, $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE) is used instead when it exists AND <ws> is a
53	#       git repository tracking .claude files (it lists `git ls-files`). No .claude/
54	#       (loa_mount: false) → manifest_sha256=none, exit 0. Prints manifest_sha256=<hex>.
55	#   check_fixture_path_rule <fixture_dir>
56	#       exit 2 (offending paths on stderr) when the fixture's top level holds
57	#       .claude, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires or .run — the mount owns
58	#       those paths (DEC-0396); exit 0 otherwise.
59	#   write_sandbox_grimoire <ws> <task_yaml> <arm> <sprint_label>
60	#       grimoires/loa/ledger.json (one active cycle, <sprint_label> planned, global 1;
61	#       the ledger-lib.sh schema), NOTES.md (header only), context/task-brief.md (the
62	#       task's agent-facing `criterion` + the TASK.md next to task.yaml),
63	#       a2a/<sprint_label>/ (empty); review-catch tasks also get a one-sprint
64	#       grimoires/loa/sprint.md naming pr/head.diff and a2a/<sprint_label>/reviewer.md
65	#       carrying pr/PR.md (sandbox copy, else the corpus fixture's). An arm whose
66	#       toggles carry sprint_plan: false (resolved from $LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, default
67	#       evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml) gets NO sprint.md. Build tasks leave sprint.md
68	#       to the PLAN phase. Nothing written names the arm.
69	#   init_sandbox_beads <ws> <task_title>
70	#       `br init --prefix bd --no-daemon` in <ws> plus one task bead with the title
71	#       when br ($LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN, default br) is on PATH → beads=br; else the opt-out
72	#       marker through <ws>/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh --opt-out →
73	#       beads=opt-out; neither → beads=none (exit 0).
74	#
75	# Hashing is Python hashlib (_sm_sha256), never .claude/ code: see _sm_sha256.
76	# Callers source this file by a literal relative path (no variable expansion
77	# on the source line), as eval.yml's trust-boundary scan requires.
78	#
79	# Evidence: every function reports `key=value` lines (one line, no newline in
80	# the value). When ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE is set they are appended to that file;
81	# else they go to the descriptor in SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD (default 1).
82	# resolve_arm_toggles prints JSON on stdout and no evidence.
83	#
84	# Tested by evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats (directly and through execute-agent.sh)
85	# and evals/tests/execute-agent.bats.
86	# =============================================================================

91	_SM_LIB_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
92	_SM_REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$_SM_LIB_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"

94	_sm_err() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; }
95	
96	# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
97	# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
98	# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
99	# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
100	# hashes the corpus the same way.
101	_sm_sha256() {
102	  python3 -I -c '
103	import hashlib, sys
104	for p in sys.argv[1:]:
105	    h = hashlib.sha256()
106	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
107	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
108	            h.update(b)
109	    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
110	}

112	# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
113	_sm_evidence() {
114	  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
115	  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
116	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
117	  else
118	    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
119	    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
120	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
121	  fi
122	}

125	mount_prompt_surface() {
126	  local ws="$1" tree="$2" skill="${3:-}"
127	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
128	  [[ -d "$tree/.claude" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: prompt tree has no .claude/: $tree"; return 2; }
129	  if [[ "$skill" == "-" ]]; then
130	    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude"
131	    cp -a "$tree/.claude/." "$ws/.claude/" || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: copying .claude/ failed"; return 2; }
132	    printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
133	    if [[ -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"; fi
134	    _sm_evidence mount "tree"
135	    return 0
136	  fi
137	  case "$skill" in */*|.*|'') _sm_err "invalid skill name '$skill'"; return 2 ;; esac
138	  local skill_src="$tree/.claude/skills/$skill"
139	  [[ -f "$skill_src/SKILL.md" ]] || { _sm_err "prompt tree $tree has no .claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
140	  mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/skills" "$ws/.claude/loa"
141	  # Whole skill dir (resources included) so guarded reads inside the skill resolve.
142	  local skill_dst="$ws/.claude/skills/$skill"
143	  mkdir -p "$skill_dst"
144	  cp -a "$skill_src/." "$skill_dst/"
145	  if [[ -f "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" ]]; then
146	    cp "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" "$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
147	  fi
148	  if [[ -d "$tree/.claude/rules" ]]; then
149	    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/rules"
150	    cp -a "$tree/.claude/rules/." "$ws/.claude/rules/"
151	  fi
152	  printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
153	  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM+x}" && -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then
154	    cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"
155	  fi

161	resolve_arm_toggles() {
162	  local arm="$1" suite_file="${2:-}"
163	  [[ "$arm" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "invalid arm id '$arm'"; return 2; }
164	  local found=0 entry=""
165	  if [[ -n "$suite_file" && -f "$suite_file" ]]; then
166	    # an unreadable suite file reads as "not declared" (cycle-129 behaviour: baseline still resolves to {})
167	    entry="$(ARM="$arm" yq -o=json -I=0 '[((.arms // [])[]), ((.ab.arms // [])[])] | map(select(.id == strenv(ARM))) | .[0] // null' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null)" \
168	      || entry=""
169	    [[ -n "$entry" && "$entry" != "null" ]] && found=1
170	  fi
171	  if [[ "$found" -eq 0 ]]; then
172	    [[ "$arm" == "baseline" ]] && { printf '{}'; return 0; }
173	    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is not declared in ${suite_file:-any suite} (arms[] / ab.arms[])"
174	    return 2
175	  fi
176	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$entry")" == "true" ]]; then
177	    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is declared absent in $suite_file (never run): $(jq -r '.evidence // "no evidence"' <<<"$entry")"
178	    return 2
179	  fi
180	  local t
181	  t="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$entry")"
182	  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$t" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not an object in $suite_file"; return 2; }
183	  printf '%s' "$t"
184	}

187	# Remove the markdown section that starts at the exact heading line $2 (up to
188	# the next level-2 heading) from file $1. Prints the number of lines removed.
189	_sm_drop_md_section() {
190	  local f="$1" heading="$2" tmpdir="$3" tmp
191	  tmp="$(mktemp "$tmpdir/.arm.XXXXXX")"
192	  awk -v h="$heading" '
193	    $0 == h { skip = 1; n++; next }
194	    skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
195	    skip { n++; next }
196	    { print }
197	    END { print n + 0 > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
198	  mv "$tmp" "$f"
199	  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
200	}

202	# Remove the first blank-line-delimited paragraph of $1 that contains one of
203	# the needles (tried in order, case-insensitive). Writes the removed text to
204	# $2; exit 1 when no needle matches.
205	_sm_drop_paragraph() {
206	  python3 -I - "$1" "$2" "look for what the review did not" "Confirm the review's demotions independently" <<'PY'
207	import re, sys
208	path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
209	text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
210	paras = re.split(r"(\n[ \t]*\n)", text)
211	for needle in sys.argv[3:]:
212	    for i in range(0, len(paras), 2):
213	        if needle.lower() in paras[i].lower():
214	            removed = paras[i]
215	            # drop the paragraph and the separator that follows it
216	            del paras[i:i + 2]
217	            open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("".join(paras))
218	            open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(removed + "\n")
219	            sys.exit(0)
220	sys.exit(1)
221	PY
222	}

224	# Strip every `effort:` line from the YAML frontmatter of file $1 (frontmatter
225	# = line 1 `---` up to the next `---`). Prints 1 when a line was removed, else 0.
226	_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort() {
227	  local f="$1" tmp
228	  tmp="$(mktemp "$f.XXXXXX")"
229	  awk '
230	    NR == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 1; print; next }
231	    fm == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 2; print; next }
232	    fm == 1 && /^effort:/ { n++; next }
233	    { print }
234	    END { print (n > 0 ? 1 : 0) > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
235	  cat "$tmp" > "$f"; rm -f "$tmp"
236	  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
237	}

239	# 0 when file $1's frontmatter still carries an `effort:` line.

242	}

330	          [[ "$nkeys" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$nkeys" -gt 0 ]] \
331	            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: no default_effort key in the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
332	          V="$val" yq -i '(.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | .default_effort) = strenv(V)' "$mc" \
333	            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: yq failed on the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
334	          local wrong
335	          wrong="$(V="$val" yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | select(.default_effort != strenv(V))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 1)"
336	          [[ "$wrong" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: default_effort did not take effect"; return 2; }
337	          cat_state="default_effort=$val in $nkeys entries"
338	          if [[ -f "$mc.checksum" ]]; then
339	            local h
340	            h="$(_sm_sha256 "$mc" | awk '{print $1}')"
341	            [[ "$h" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: could not hash model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
342	            printf '%s\n' "$h" > "$mc.checksum"
343	            cat_state="$cat_state; .checksum refreshed"
344	          fi
345	        fi
346	        _sm_evidence effort "$val"
347	        _sm_evidence effort_skills_stripped "$stripped/$total"
348	        _sm_evidence effort_catalog "$cat_state"
349	        ;;
350	      gates)
351	        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled .flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled \
352	          || { _sm_err "gates toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
353	        export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
354	        if [[ -n "${ARM_ENV_FILE:-}" ]]; then printf 'LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false\n' >> "$ARM_ENV_FILE"; fi
355	        _sm_evidence gates "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false"
356	        _sm_evidence arm_env "LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false"
357	        ;;
358	      flatline)
359	        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.enabled \
360	          || { _sm_err "flatline toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
361	        _sm_evidence flatline "flatline_protocol.enabled=false"
362	        ;;
363	      sprint_plan)
364	        _sm_evidence sprint_plan "phase set without PLAN (pipeline executor); no sprint.md materialised"
365	        ;;
366	      context_resets)
367	        _sm_evidence context_resets "implementer phases continue one session (pipeline executor)"
368	        ;;
369	      *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' declares unknown toggle '$key'"; return 2 ;;
370	    esac
371	  done < <(jq -r 'to_entries[] | [.key, (.value | tostring)] | @tsv' <<<"$toggles")
372	  return 0
373	}

375	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
376	regen_sandbox_manifest() {
377	  local ws="$1"
378	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
379	  if [[ ! -d "$ws/.claude" ]]; then
380	    _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "none"
381	    return 0
382	  fi
383	  local out="$ws/.claude/checksums.json" tool="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT}/tools/gen-checksums.sh" how="inline"
384	  if [[ -x "$tool" ]] && git -C "$ws" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 \
385	     && [[ -n "$(git -C "$ws" ls-files .claude 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]]; then
386	    "$tool" --root "$ws" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $tool --root $ws failed"; return 2; }
387	    how="gen-checksums.sh"
388	  else
389	    local list="$ws/.eval/.manifest-files" sums="$ws/.eval/.manifest-sums"
390	    mkdir -p "$ws/.eval"
391	    ( cd "$ws" && find .claude -type f ! -path '.claude/overrides/*' ! -path '.claude/checksums.json' -print ) \
392	      | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
393	    if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: a path under .claude/ holds a backslash"; rm -f "$list"; return 2; fi
394	    : > "$sums"
395	    local -a batch=()
396	    local f
397	    while IFS= read -r f; do
398	      batch+=("$f")
399	      if [[ ${#batch[@]} -ge 200 ]]; then
400	        ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
401	        batch=()
402	      fi
403	    done < "$list"
404	    if [[ ${#batch[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
405	      ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
406	    fi
407	    jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
408	      {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
409	       files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | capture("^(?<h>[0-9a-f]{64})  (?<p>.+)$") | {key: .p, value: .h}] | from_entries)}' \
410	      < "$sums" > "$out.tmp" || { rm -f "$out.tmp" "$list" "$sums"; _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: could not write the manifest"; return 2; }
411	    mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
412	    rm -f "$list" "$sums"
413	  fi
414	  jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $out is not a manifest"; return 2; }
415	  local digest
416	  digest="$(_sm_sha256 "$out" | awk '{print $1}')"
417	  _sm_evidence manifest_files "$(jq '.files | length' "$out") ($how)"
418	  _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "$digest"
419	  return 0
420	}

422	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
423	check_fixture_path_rule() {
424	  local dir="$1"
425	  [[ -d "$dir" ]] || { _sm_err "check_fixture_path_rule: fixture not found: $dir"; return 2; }
426	  local p bad=""
427	  for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml grimoires .run; do
428	    if [[ -e "$dir/$p" || -L "$dir/$p" ]]; then bad="$bad $p"; fi
429	  done
430	  if [[ -n "$bad" ]]; then
431	    echo "fixture path rule: $dir holds paths the Loa mount owns:$bad" >&2
432	    return 2
433	  fi
434	  return 0
435	}

438	write_sandbox_grimoire() {
439	  local ws="$1" task="$2" arm="$3" label="${4:-sprint-1}"
440	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
441	  [[ -f "$task" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task yaml not found: $task"; return 2; }
442	  [[ "$label" =~ ^sprint-[0-9]{1,4}$ ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: invalid sprint label '$label'"; return 2; }
443	  local tid ttype criterion task_md
444	  tid="$(yq -r '.id // ""' "$task")"; ttype="$(yq -r '.type // ""' "$task")"
445	  criterion="$(yq -r '.criterion // ""' "$task")"
446	  [[ "$tid" =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task id '$tid' invalid"; return 2; }
447	  [[ -n "$criterion" && "$criterion" != "null" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task $tid has no criterion"; return 2; }
448	  task_md="$(dirname "$task")/TASK.md"
449	  [[ -f "$task_md" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: no TASK.md beside $task"; return 2; }
450	
451	  local sprint_plan=true
452	  if [[ -n "$arm" ]]; then
453	    local sf="${LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml}" tg
454	    if tg="$(resolve_arm_toggles "$arm" "$sf" 2>/dev/null)"; then
455	      [[ "$(jq -r 'if has("sprint_plan") then (.sprint_plan | tostring) else "true" end' <<<"$tg")" == "false" ]] && sprint_plan=false
456	    fi
457	  fi
458	
459	  local g="$ws/grimoires/loa" now
460	  now="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
461	  mkdir -p "$g/context" "$g/a2a/$label"
462	  jq -n --arg now "$now" --arg label "$label" --arg tid "$tid" '
463	    {version: 1, schema_version: 1, created: $now, last_updated: $now,
464	     next_sprint_number: 2, global_sprint_counter: 1, active_cycle: "cycle-001",
465	     cycles: [{id: "cycle-001", label: ("eval task " + $tid), status: "active", created: $now,
466	               archived: null, archive_path: null, prd: null, sdd: null,
467	               sprints: [{global_id: 1, local_label: $label, status: "planned", created: $now, completed: null}]}],
468	     bugfixes: [], bugfix_cycles: []}' > "$g/ledger.json" \
469	    || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: ledger write failed"; return 2; }
470	  printf '# NOTES\n' > "$g/NOTES.md"
471	  {
472	    printf '# Task brief\n\n## Criterion\n\n%s\n\n## Task\n\n' "$criterion"
473	    cat "$task_md"
474	  } > "$g/context/task-brief.md"
475	  local wrote="ledger.json NOTES.md context/task-brief.md a2a/$label/"
476	
477	  if [[ "$ttype" == "review-catch" && "$sprint_plan" == "true" ]]; then
478	    {
479	      printf '# Sprint Plan\n\n## Sprint %s: Review the pull request in pr/\n\n' "${label#sprint-}"
480	      printf 'The change under review is `pr/head.diff` (unified diff, base to head). The files before the change are under `pr/base/`, after it under `pr/head/`; `pr/PR.md` is the pull request description and is the implementation report for this sprint.\n\n'
481	      printf '### Tasks\n\n- [x] Task 1.1: the change in `pr/head.diff`\n\n'
482	      printf '### Review scope\n\nThe gates review `pr/head.diff` (pass `--diff-file pr/head.diff` to the adversarial review). Cite findings as `head/<path>:<line>` with lines from the `pr/head/` files.\n\n'
483	      printf '## Success Criteria\n\n%s\n' "$criterion"
484	    } > "$g/sprint.md"
485	    local prmd="$ws/pr/PR.md" rcfx
486	    if [[ ! -f "$prmd" ]]; then
487	      rcfx="$(yq -r '.review_catch.fixture // ""' "$task")"
488	      case "$rcfx" in *..*|/*) rcfx="" ;; esac
489	      prmd="$_SM_REPO_ROOT/evals/fixtures/$rcfx/PR.md"
490	    fi
491	    [[ -f "$prmd" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: no PR.md for review-catch task $tid"; return 2; }
492	    { printf '# Implementation Report: %s\n\n' "$label"; cat "$prmd"; } > "$g/a2a/$label/reviewer.md"
493	    wrote="$wrote sprint.md a2a/$label/reviewer.md"
494	  fi
495	  _sm_evidence grimoire "$wrote"
496	  return 0
497	}
498	
499	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
500	init_sandbox_beads() {
501	  local ws="$1" title="${2:-}"
502	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "init_sandbox_beads: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
503	  [[ -n "$title" ]] || title="eval task"

content.content:
1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
     4	#
     5	# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
     6	# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes under
     7	# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-{review,audit}.json, the
     8	# transcripts' tool inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch
     9	# MANIFEST.json (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
    10	#
    11	# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
    12	# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
    13	# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).
    14	#
    15	# Derived fields:
    16	#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
    17	#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
    18	#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
    19	#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
    20	#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
    21	#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
    22	#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
    23	#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) a models_used key differs from
    24	#                   model_requested (ids compared without the Bedrock region prefix),
    25	#                   (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
    26	#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
    27	#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
    28	#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
    29	#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
    30	#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
    31	#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
    32	#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
    33	#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl
    34	#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
    35	#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
    36	#
    37	# Usage:
    38	#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
    39	#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
    40	#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
    41	#
    42	# Options:
    43	#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
    44	#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
    45	#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
    46	#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
    47	#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
    48	#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
    49	#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
    50	#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
    51	#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
    52	#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
    53	#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums; exit 1 on the first
    54	#                      bad row naming its line number
    55	#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
    56	#
    57	# Exit codes:
    58	#   0  row written / file valid
    59	#   1  --validate found a bad row
    60	#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch
    61	#
    62	# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under
    63	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    64	# =============================================================================
    65	set -euo pipefail
    66	export LC_ALL=C
    67	
    68	RUN_DIR="" TASK_YAML="" GRADE="" MANIFEST="" STATUS_OVERRIDE="" ATTEMPTS=1 RETRY_REASON="" OUT=""
    69	VALIDATE="" ALLOW_UNGRADED=false
    70	usage() { echo "ablation-row.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    71	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    72	  case "$1" in
    73	    --run-dir)        RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    74	    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    75	    --grade)          GRADE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    76	    --manifest)       MANIFEST="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    77	    --status)         STATUS_OVERRIDE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    78	    --attempts)       ATTEMPTS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    79	    --retry-reason)   RETRY_REASON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    80	    --out)            OUT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    81	    --validate)       VALIDATE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    82	    --allow-ungraded) ALLOW_UNGRADED=true; shift ;;
    83	    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,62p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    84	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    85	  esac
    86	done
    87	
    88	STATUSES='["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","transport_error","infrastructure_error","interrupted","contaminated"]'
    89	
    90	# --- validate ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    91	if [[ -n "$VALIDATE" ]]; then
    92	  [[ -f "$VALIDATE" && -r "$VALIDATE" ]] || usage "cannot read $VALIDATE"
    93	  n=0 bad=0
    94	  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    95	    n=$((n + 1))
    96	    [[ -n "${line//[[:space:]]/}" ]] || continue
    97	    err="$(jq -r --argjson st "$STATUSES" --argjson ungraded "$ALLOW_UNGRADED" '
    98	      def t(v; ts): (v | type) as $ty | (ts | index($ty)) != null;
    99	      def need(k; ts): if has(k) | not then "missing field \(k)"
   100	                       elif t(.[k]; ts) | not then "field \(k) has type \(.[k] | type), want \(ts | join("|"))"
   101	                       else empty end;
   102	      def num: ["number"]; def numn: ["number","null"]; def str: ["string"]; def strn: ["string","null"];
   103	      def objn: ["object","null"]; def booln: ["boolean","null"];
   104	      if type != "object" then "row is not a JSON object" else (.) as $row |
   105	      [ need("schema_version"; num), need("run_id"; str), need("batch"; str), need("arm"; str),
   106	        need("task_id"; str), need("task_type"; str), need("trial"; num), need("source_commit"; str),
   107	        need("suite_manifest_sha256"; strn), need("suite_version"; ["number","string","null"]),
   108	        need("host_fingerprint"; strn), need("image_digest"; strn), need("agy_opt_in"; ["boolean"]),
   109	        need("started"; str), need("finished"; strn), need("phases"; ["array"]),
   110	        need("voices_run"; objn), need("hidden_tests"; objn), need("hidden_test_pass_rate"; numn),
   111	        need("defects_seeded"; numn), need("defects_caught"; numn), need("defect_catch_rate"; numn),
   112	        need("flags"; numn), need("false_positives"; numn), need("verdict"; strn),
   113	        need("verdict_accuracy"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_review"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_audit"; booln),
   114	        need("regressions"; numn), need("diff_lines"; numn), need("files_changed"; numn),
   115	        need("cost_usd"; num), need("wall_clock_ms"; num), need("tokens_in"; num), need("tokens_out"; num),
   116	        need("stalls"; num), need("attempts"; num), need("retry_reason"; strn),
   117	        need("degraded"; ["boolean"]), need("degraded_reason"; strn), need("status"; str),
   118	        need("snapshots"; ["object"]), need("contaminated"; objn), need("zone_violations"; ["object"]) ][0]
   119	      // (if (["feature-build","bug-fix","refactor","review-catch"] | index($row.task_type)) == null
   120	           then "task_type \(.task_type) is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" else empty end)
   121	      // (if ($st | index($row.status)) == null then "status \(.status) is not one of \($st | join("|"))" else empty end)
   122	      // (if (.zone_violations.dot_claude_writes | type) != "array" then "zone_violations.dot_claude_writes is not an array" else empty end)
   123	      // (if (.degraded == true) and (.degraded_reason == null) then "degraded without degraded_reason" else empty end)
   124	      // (if .verdict != null and ((["APPROVED","CHANGES_REQUIRED"] | index($row.verdict)) == null)
   125	           then "verdict \(.verdict) is not APPROVED|CHANGES_REQUIRED" else empty end)
   126	      // ([.snapshots | to_entries[] | select((.value | type) != "string" and (.value | type) != "null")
   127	           | "snapshots.\(.key) is not a string"][0])
   128	      // ([.phases | to_entries[] | .key as $i | .value as $p
   129	           | ( if ($p | type) != "object" then "phases[\($i)] is not an object" else
   130	               ([ ($p | need("name"; str)), ($p | need("session_id"; strn)), ($p | need("model_requested"; str)),
   131	                  ($p | need("models_used"; ["object"])), ($p | need("effort_requested"; strn)),
   132	                  ($p | need("effort_effective"; strn)), ($p | need("tokens_in"; num)), ($p | need("tokens_out"; num)),
   133	                  ($p | need("cache_read_tokens"; num)), ($p | need("cache_creation_tokens"; num)),
   134	                  ($p | need("cost_usd"; num)), ($p | need("duration_ms"; num)), ($p | need("num_turns"; num)),
   135	                  ($p | need("exit"; num)), ($p | need("refusal_fallbacks"; ["array"])) ][0]
   136	                | if . then "phases[\($i)]: \(.)" else empty end) end )][0])
   137	      // (if $ungraded then empty
   138	          elif (["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","contaminated"] | index($row.status)) == null then empty
   139	          elif .task_type == "review-catch" then
   140	            (if (.defect_catch_rate | type) != "number" then "graded review-catch row has no defect_catch_rate (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
   141	          else
   142	            (if (.hidden_tests | type) != "object" or (.hidden_test_pass_rate | type) != "number"
   143	               then "graded build row has no hidden_tests (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
   144	          end)
   145	      // empty
   146	      end' 2>/dev/null <<<"$line")" || err="line is not valid JSON"
   147	    if [[ -n "$err" ]]; then
   148	      echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE:$n: $err" >&2
   149	      exit 1
   150	    fi
   151	  done < "$VALIDATE"
   152	  echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE: $n rows valid"
   153	  exit 0
   154	fi
   155	
   156	# --- build a row -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   157	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "missing --run-dir (or --validate)"
   158	[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "missing --task-yaml"
   159	[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
   160	PIPE="$RUN_DIR/meta/pipeline.json"

ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$ARM" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
ALL_ARM_IDS="$(jq -r '[.arms // [] | .[] | .id] | .[]' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
REFUSAL=""
if [[ -z "$ARM_DEF" ]]; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is not declared in the suite"
elif [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == "true" ]]; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is declared absent: true"
elif ! jq -e --arg k "$KIND" --arg t "$TASK_TYPE" \
       '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
       >/dev/null <<<"$ARM_DEF"; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' does not apply to task type '$TASK_TYPE' (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
fi
[[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || ARM_DEF='{}'
SUITE_TOGGLES="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"

# plan_phases <toggles-json> → JSON array of {name,label}
plan_phases() {
  jq -c -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --argjson tg "$1" --arg kind "$KIND" '
    ( if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end ) as $dflt
    | ( $arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt ) as $p0
    | ( if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end ) as $p1
    | ( if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end ) as $p2
    | ( if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null
          then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end ) as $p3
    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += [{name: "FIX", label: ("FIX" + (.fix | tostring))}]
        else .out += [{name: $n, label: $n}] end)
    | .out'
}

phase_skill() {  # the Loa skill a phase invokes (for effort_requested)
  case "$1" in
    PLAN) echo planning-sprints ;; IMPLEMENT|FIX) echo implementing-tasks ;;
    REVIEW) echo reviewing-code ;; AUDIT) echo auditing-security ;; *) echo "" ;;
  esac
}
builtin_model() { case "$1" in REVIEW|AUDIT) echo global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1 ;; *) echo global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 ;; esac; }
builtin_turns() { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 30 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 60 ;; REVIEW|FIX|AUDIT) echo 40 ;; BARE) echo 170 ;; *) echo 40 ;; esac; }
builtin_tmin()  { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 15 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 25 ;; REVIEW|AUDIT) echo 20 ;; FIX) echo 15 ;; BARE) echo 70 ;; *) echo 20 ;; esac; }

phase_model() {
  jq -r --arg n "$1" --arg d "$(builtin_model "$1")" --argjson o "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" \
    '$o[$n] // .phase_defaults.models[$n] // $d' <<<"$SUITE_JSON"
}
phase_cap() {  # phase_cap <name> max_turns|timeout_min — task bounds > suite phase_defaults > built-in;
               # BARE without a declaration = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX
  local n="$1" key="$2" v
  v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.bounds[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
  [[ -n "$v" ]] || v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.phase_defaults[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  if [[ -z "$v" && "$n" == "BARE" ]]; then
    v=$(( $(phase_cap PLAN "$key") + $(phase_cap IMPLEMENT "$key") + 2 * $(phase_cap FIX "$key") ))
  fi
  if [[ -z "$v" ]]; then
    if [[ "$key" == max_turns ]]; then v="$(builtin_turns "$n")"; else v="$(builtin_tmin "$n")"; fi
  fi
  printf '%s' "$v"
}
phase_timeout_s() {
  local o; o="$(jq -r --arg n "$1" '.[$n] // empty' <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON")"
  if [[ -n "$o" ]]; then printf '%s' "$o"; else printf '%s' $(( $(phase_cap "$1" timeout_min) * 60 )); fi
}
TOOLS="$(jq -r --arg d "$TOOLS_DEFAULT" '.phase_defaults.tools // $d | if type == "array" then join(",") else . end' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
EFFORT_FLAG="$(jq -r '.effort // .toggles.effort // empty' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
case "$EFFORT_FLAG" in ""|low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) die_usage "arm effort '$EFFORT_FLAG' is not low|medium|high|xhigh|max" ;; esac

if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == true ]]; then
  if [[ -n "$REFUSAL" ]]; then echo "pipeline-run.sh: refused: $REFUSAL" >&2; exit 2; fi
  plan="$(plan_phases "$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  single="$(jq -r '.context_resets == false' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  echo "plan: task $TASK_ID type $TASK_TYPE arm $ARM executor $EXECUTOR cap USD $MAX_RUN_USD phases $(jq -r 'map(.label + (if .name == "FIX" then "?" else "" end)) | join(",")' <<<"$plan")"
  i=0
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r name label; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    sess=new
    if [[ "$single" == true ]]; then case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) sess=implementer ;; esac; fi
    cond=""; [[ "$name" == FIX ]] && cond=" when=CHANGES_REQUIRED"
    printf 'phase %d %s model=%s max_turns=%s timeout_s=%s effort=%s session=%s%s\n' "$i" "$label" \
      "$(phase_model "$name")" "$(phase_cap "$name" max_turns)" "$(phase_timeout_s "$name")" \
      "${EFFORT_FLAG:--}" "$sess" "$cond"
  done < <(jq -r '.[] | [.name, .label] | @tsv' <<<"$plan")
  exit 0
fi

# --- run directory --------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ -e "$RUN_DIR" ]] && [[ -n "$(ls -A "$RUN_DIR" 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
  die_usage "run dir exists and is not empty: $RUN_DIR"
fi
mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR"
RUN_DIR="$(cd "$RUN_DIR" && pwd)"
WS="$RUN_DIR/sandbox" META="$RUN_DIR/meta" SNAPS="$RUN_DIR/snapshots" TRANS="$RUN_DIR/transcripts" EVALD="$RUN_DIR/eval"
mkdir -p "$WS" "$META" "$SNAPS" "$TRANS" "$EVALD"
printf '%s\n' "$ARM" > "$META/arm"
PHASES_FILE="$META/phases.jsonl"; : > "$PHASES_FILE"
export ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE="$META/arm-evidence.txt"; : > "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
MOUNT_LOG="$META/mount.log"; : > "$MOUNT_LOG"

STARTED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
STATUS="running" CAP_PHASE="" CAP_TURN="null" REASON="" FINAL_WRITTEN=0
INTERRUPTED=0 CUR_PID="" CUR_CONTAINER=""
SPENT_MICRO=0 IMAGE_DIGEST="" FINGERPRINT="" SNAPSHOTS_JSON='{}' TOGGLES="$SUITE_TOGGLES"
SOURCE_COMMIT="$(git -C "$SOURCE_TREE" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
SUITE_VERSION="$(jq -c --argjson t "$TASK_JSON" '$t.suite_version // .suite_version // .version // null' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
    grep -qF -e "$id" "$f" && { echo "arm id $id"; return 1; }
  done <<<"$ALL_ARM_IDS"
  return 0
}
if [[ -f "$WS/grimoires/loa/context/task-brief.md" ]]; then
  why="$(leak_scan "$WS/grimoires/loa/context/task-brief.md")" || infra "task-brief.md leaks $why"
fi

# --- prompts (D-4.4) -----------------------------------------------------------------
subst() {  # subst <text> <key> <value>
  local text="$1" key="{{$2}}" val="$3"
  printf '%s' "${text//"$key"/$val}"
}
if [[ "$KIND" == review-catch ]]; then
  CHANGE_NOTE="The change under review is the pull request in \`pr/\`: \`pr/head.diff\` is the complete change (base to head), \`pr/base/\` and \`pr/head/\` hold every touched file before and after it, and \`pr/PR.md\` is its description (also carried as the implementation report). Cite findings as \`head/<path>:<line>\` with line numbers from the \`pr/head/\` files. When your skill runs the adversarial dissent, pass \`--diff-file pr/head.diff\`."
else
  CHANGE_NOTE="The change under review is the diff from the base commit \`$BASE_COMMIT\` to the current tree (\`git diff $BASE_COMMIT\`)."
fi
build_prompt() {  # build_prompt <name> <out-file>
  local name="$1" out="$2" tpl text contract tc
  tpl="$(cat "$PROMPTS_DIR/$name.md")"
  if [[ "$name" == BARE ]]; then
    if [[ -f "$TASK_DIR/TASK.md" ]]; then text="$(cat "$TASK_DIR/TASK.md")"
    elif [[ "$KIND" == review-catch && -f "$WS/pr/REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md" ]]; then text="$(cat "$WS/pr/REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md")"
    else text="$(jq -r '.criterion // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"; fi
    if [[ "$KIND" == review-catch ]]; then
      contract="The pull request is under \`pr/\` (\`pr/PR.md\`, \`pr/head.diff\`, \`pr/base/\`, \`pr/head/\`). Write your findings to \`review.md\` at the repository root: one line per finding as \`head/<path>:<line> — <description>\` with line numbers from the \`pr/head/\` files, and a final line \`Verdict: APPROVED\` or \`Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED\`."
    else
      tc="$(jq -r '.test_command // [] | if type == "array" then join(" ") else . end' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
      contract="Test command: \`$tc\`. Write your changes in place; run the tests; stop when they pass."
    fi
    tpl="$(subst "$tpl" TASK_TEXT "$text")"
    tpl="$(subst "$tpl" CONTRACT "$contract")"
  fi
  tpl="$(subst "$tpl" SPRINT "$SPRINT")"
  tpl="$(subst "$tpl" TASK_ID "$TASK_ID")"
  tpl="$(subst "$tpl" FLATLINE "$FLATLINE")"
  tpl="$(subst "$tpl" CHANGE_NOTE "$CHANGE_NOTE")"
  printf '%s\n' "$tpl" > "$out"
}

# --- per-run HOME (container mode; DEC-0411 as amended in Sprint 258) -------------------------
# One writable host directory mounted at /home/evaluser: the CLI's session store lives
# there for the whole run (A6 --resume continues across phases), and it holds only the
# codex CLI's own files. ~/.claude/.credentials.json and ~/.claude/settings.json are never
# copied: the Bedrock route authenticates from AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK in the environment,
# and --setting-sources project ignores user settings.
CREDS_HOME="${LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME:-$HOME}"
make_home() {
  local f
  mkdir -p "$HOME_DIR/.claude" "$HOME_DIR/.aws" "$HOME_DIR/.codex"
  # the sandbox project is pre-trusted so the mounted tree's project settings apply without the dialog
  # (the CLI otherwise ignores permissions.allow and warns; lead, Sprint 258 smoke)
  printf '{"projects":{"/workspace":{"hasTrustDialogAccepted":true}}}\n' > "$HOME_DIR/.claude.json"
  for f in auth.json config.toml; do
    if [[ -f "$CREDS_HOME/.codex/$f" ]]; then cp "$CREDS_HOME/.codex/$f" "$HOME_DIR/.codex/$f"; fi
  done
  chmod 0700 "$HOME_DIR" "$HOME_DIR/.claude" "$HOME_DIR/.aws" "$HOME_DIR/.codex"
}
[[ "$EXECUTOR" == container ]] && make_home

# --- pricing (one lookup per model; D-4.10) ---------------------------------------------
PRICE_CACHE=""
price_for() {  # price_for <model id> → {"in":…,"out":…,"cr":…,"cc":…} micro-USD per Mtok, or null
  local m="$1" hit alias j
  hit="$(printf '%s\n' "$PRICE_CACHE" | awk -F'\t' -v m="$m" '$1 == m {print $2; exit}')"

#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created
#
# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-*.json
#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
#
# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
#     -v <run>/sandbox:/workspace:rw -v <run>/meta/home:/home/evaluser:rw
#     -w /workspace -e <KEY=value…> -e AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK <image> python3 -I -c <shim> … claude …
# Exactly two mounts. meta/home/ (mode 0700) holds copies of $HOME/.codex/{auth.json,
# config.toml} when present and empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store
# lives there for the whole run, so A6's --resume works across phases. No ~/.claude
# file is ever copied. The directory is deleted at exit and on interrupt.
# image_digest = the image's RepoDigest or id (container), else the fingerprint (host).
# Versions: `fingerprint` is computed from the HOST toolchain; in container mode the
# toolchain that runs the phases is the image's (Claude Code 2.1.299, codex 0.137.0 by

    > "$META/pipeline.json.tmp" && mv "$META/pipeline.json.tmp" "$META/pipeline.json"
}

    69	     took_effect: [no_flatline_rows, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
    70	  - {id: a6_one_window, label: A6, task_types: [build], toggles: {context_resets: false},
    71	     took_effect: [implementer_single_session, gates_separate_sessions, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
    72	  - {id: a7_effort_medium, label: A7, task_types: [all], toggles: {effort: medium},
