    76	
    77	rules:   # D-A5: pre-registered, mirrored in NOTES
    78	  threshold_points: 0.03
    79	  cost_lower_pct: 15
    80	  bootstrap: {resamples: 10000, level: 0.90, paired: true, units: {hidden_test_pass_rate: tasks, defect_catch_rate: defects}, also_report: {defect_catch_rate: tasks}}   # DEC-0399
    81	  primaries_by_arm: {build_only: [hidden_test_pass_rate], all_types: [hidden_test_pass_rate, defect_catch_rate]}   # DEC-0400
    82	  cap_failure: counts_as_failed            # 0 on each applicable primary (DEC-0393)
    83	  exclusion: {statuses: [degraded, contaminated, interrupted], mode: pairwise, inconclusive_above_share: 0.25}
    84	  sensitivity_figure: cap_failures_excluded  # printed, never decides
    85	  multiple_comparisons: none                 # expected false positives at 0.90 over 6 components printed
    86	  drift_guard: {cli_version: fixed_per_batch, model_ids: fixed_per_batch}   # DEC-0407
    87	  order: trial_major_seeded_shuffle_within_block
    88	  took_effect_per_trial: true                # a miss → infrastructure_error, arm paused until --clear-arm (DEC-0418)
    89	  predicates:                                # DEC-0416; d = arm − A1 point estimate, [lo, hi] its 90 % interval, c/w = cost/wall-clock Δ %
    90	    investigate: "any applicable primary has lo > 0"
    91	    keep: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03 and hi < 0"
    92	    inconclusive: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03, or the arm's excluded share > 0.25, or no valid pair"
    93	    remove: "else every applicable primary has d >= -0.03 and (c <= -15 or w <= -15)"
    94	    simplify: "else (every applicable primary within -0.03, cost similar)"
    95	  review_catch: {defect_counts_once_across_gates: true, false_positive_dedupe: cited_region, verdict_accurate_iff: "CHANGES_REQUIRED when the key holds a high or critical defect, APPROVED when none"}   # DEC-0420
    96	  inconclusive_extension_trials: 2
    97	  h1: "a1_full beats a0_bare on at least one primary with the interval excluding zero, else halt before promotion"
    98	  a4_sensitivity: "a4_no_gates worse than a1_full on hidden_test_pass_rate with the interval excluding zero, else harden tasks before acting on other arms"
    99	  decision_states: [investigate, keep, inconclusive, remove, simplify, not_run_cut, inconclusive_by_power]
   100	  mde_cut: 0.10   # sprint Task 3.4: an arm whose MDE at affordable trials exceeds this is pre-declared inconclusive_by_power and not run

--task-yaml) TASK_YAML="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --workspace) WORKSPACE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --run-id) RUN_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --trial-id) TRIAL_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --timeout) TIMEOUT_S="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --help|-h) usage ;;
    *) echo "ERROR: Unknown option: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" && -n "$WORKSPACE" ]] || { echo "ERROR: --task-yaml and --workspace are required" >&2; exit 2; }
[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || { echo "ERROR: task YAML not found: $TASK_YAML" >&2; exit 2; }
[[ -d "$WORKSPACE" ]] || { echo "ERROR: workspace not found: $WORKSPACE" >&2; exit 2; }
WORKSPACE="$(cd "$WORKSPACE" && pwd)"

# --- 1. gate ---------------------------------------------------------------
skill="$(yq -r '.agent.skill // ""' "$TASK_YAML")"
if [[ -z "$skill" || "$skill" == "null" ]]; then
  echo "execute-agent: task declares no .agent.skill — nothing to run" >&2
  exit 3
fi
case "$skill" in
  */*|.*|'') echo "ERROR: invalid skill name '$skill'" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

PROMPT_TREE="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$REPO_ROOT}"
PROMPT_TREE="$(cd "$PROMPT_TREE" && pwd)"
CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
MODEL="${EVAL_MODEL:-claude-sonnet-5}"
MAX_TURNS="${EVAL_MAX_TURNS:-40}"

skill_src="$PROMPT_TREE/.claude/skills/$skill"
[[ -f "$skill_src/SKILL.md" ]] || { echo "ERROR: prompt tree $PROMPT_TREE has no .claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v "$CLAUDE_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [[ -x "$CLAUDE_BIN" ]] || { echo "ERROR: CLI not found: $CLAUDE_BIN (set EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN)" >&2; exit 2; }

# --- 2. materialize ----------------------------------------------------------
eval_dir="$WORKSPACE/.eval"
mkdir -p "$eval_dir" "$WORKSPACE/.claude/skills" "$WORKSPACE/.claude/loa"

# Whole skill dir (resources included) so guarded reads inside the skill resolve.
skill_dst="$WORKSPACE/.claude/skills/$skill"
mkdir -p "$skill_dst"
cp -a "$skill_src/." "$skill_dst/"
if [[ -f "$PROMPT_TREE/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" ]]; then
  cp "$PROMPT_TREE/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" "$WORKSPACE/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
fi
if [[ -d "$PROMPT_TREE/.claude/rules" ]]; then
  mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.claude/rules"
  cp -a "$PROMPT_TREE/.claude/rules/." "$WORKSPACE/.claude/rules/"
fi
printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$WORKSPACE/CLAUDE.md"

# --- 2b. control arm (cycle-129 FR-2) -----------------------------------------
ARM_MODE=false
[[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM+x}" ]] && ARM_MODE=true
ARM="${LOA_EVAL_ARM:-baseline}"
[[ "$ARM" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { echo "ERROR: invalid LOA_EVAL_ARM '$ARM'" >&2; exit 2; }

  cp "$PROMPT_TREE/.loa.config.yaml" "$WORKSPACE/.loa.config.yaml"

# The arm's toggles: explicit JSON, else the suite's ab.arms[] entry.
resolve_toggles() {
  # audit r1 DISS-C-001: toggles exist only in arm mode (LOA_EVAL_ARM set); a stale
  # LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES in a non-arm environment is ignored, and the baseline arm
  # never carries toggles.
  if [[ "$ARM_MODE" != "true" ]]; then
    [[ -z "${LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES:-}" ]] || echo "WARN: LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES is set but LOA_EVAL_ARM is not: ignored (not an arm run)" >&2
    printf '{}'; return 0
  fi
  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES:-}" ]]; then
    jq -ce 'if type == "object" then . else error("not an object") end' <<<"$LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES" 2>/dev/null \
      || { echo "ERROR: LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES is not a JSON object" >&2; return 2; }
    if [[ "$ARM" == "baseline" && "$(jq -c 'length' <<<"$LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES")" != "0" ]]; then
      echo "ERROR: the baseline arm takes no toggles (LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES=$LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES)" >&2; return 2
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  local suite_file="${LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE:-}"
  if [[ -z "$suite_file" ]]; then
    local tdir; tdir="$(basename "$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")")"
    [[ -f "$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/$tdir.yaml" ]] && suite_file="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/$tdir.yaml"
  fi
  local t="" found=0
  if [[ -n "$suite_file" && -f "$suite_file" ]]; then
    found="$(ARM="$ARM" yq '[.ab.arms[]? | select(.id == strenv(ARM))] | length' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
    [[ "$found" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || found=0
    if [[ "$found" -gt 0 ]]; then

    fi
  fi
  if [[ "$found" -eq 0 || -z "$t" || "$t" == "null" ]]; then
    [[ "$ARM" == "baseline" ]] && { printf '{}'; return 0; }
    echo "ERROR: arm '$ARM' is not declared in ${suite_file:-any suite} (ab.arms[])" >&2
    return 2
  fi
  printf '%s' "$t"
}

_drop_md_section() {
  local f="$1" heading="$2" tmp
  tmp="$(mktemp "$eval_dir/.arm.XXXXXX")"
  awk -v h="$heading" '
    $0 == h { skip = 1; n++; next }
    skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
    skip { n++; next }
    { print }
    END { print n + 0 > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"

}

_drop_paragraph() {
  python3 -I - "$1" "$2" "look for what the review did not" "Confirm the review's demotions independently" <<'PY'
import re, sys
path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
paras = re.split(r"(\n[ \t]*\n)", text)
for needle in sys.argv[3:]:
    for i in range(0, len(paras), 2):
        if needle.lower() in paras[i].lower():

            # drop the paragraph and the separator that follows it

            sys.exit(0)

}

ARM_EVIDENCE='{}'

  local key val
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r key val; do
    [[ -n "$key" ]] || continue
    if [[ "$val" != "false" ]]; then

        [[ "$(yq -r '.flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice' "$cfg")" == "false" ]] \
          || { echo "ERROR: companion_voice toggle did not take effect" >&2; return 2; }
        _evidence companion_voice "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false"
        ;;
      karpathy_block)
        local k="$WORKSPACE/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" n
        [[ -f "$k" ]] || { echo "ERROR: karpathy_block toggle: no sandbox CLAUDE.loa.md" >&2; return 2; }
        n="$(_drop_md_section "$k" '## Karpathy Principles')"

            || { rm -f "$cj.tmp"; echo "ERROR: karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json could not be rewritten" >&2; return 2; }
          mv "$cj.tmp" "$cj"
          cjn="$(jq '[(.constraints // [])[] | select(tostring | test("karpathy"; "i"))] | length' "$cj" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")"
          [[ "$cjn" == "0" ]] || { echo "ERROR: karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json still carries Karpathy rows ($cjn)" >&2; return 2; }
        fi
        _evidence karpathy_block "removed ${n} lines from CLAUDE.loa.md; constraints.json karpathy rows after: ${cjn}"
        ;;
      rule_files)
        local r gone=""
        for r in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
          if [[ -e "$WORKSPACE/.claude/rules/$r" ]]; then rm -f "$WORKSPACE/.claude/rules/$r"; gone="$gone $r"; fi
          [[ ! -e "$WORKSPACE/.claude/rules/$r" ]] || { echo "ERROR: rule_files toggle: $r still present" >&2; return 2; }
        done

        ;;

        local s="$WORKSPACE/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"

        _evidence audit_delta_instruction "removed $(wc -c < "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" | tr -d ' ') bytes (.eval/arm-removed.txt)"
        ;;
      *) echo "ERROR: arm '$ARM' declares unknown toggle '$key'" >&2; return 2 ;;
    esac
  done < <(jq -r 'to_entries[] | [.key, (.value | tostring)] | @tsv' <<<"$ARM_TOGGLES")
  return 0
}
apply_toggles || exit 2

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
     4	# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
     5	#
     6	# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
     7	# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
     8	# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
     9	# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
    10	# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
    11	#
    12	# Rules:
    13	#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
    14	#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
    15	#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
    16	#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
    17	#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
    18	#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
    19	#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
    20	#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
    21	#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
    22	#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
    23	#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
    24	#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
    25	#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
    26	#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
    27	#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
    28	#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
    29	#                              each other and from every implementer session id
    30	#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
    31	#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
    32	#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
    33	#                              are not frontmatter)
    34	#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
    35	#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
    36	#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
    37	#                              "no mount"
    38	#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
    39	#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
    40	#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
    41	# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
    42	#
    43	# Usage:
    44	#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    45	#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    46	#
    47	# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
    48	# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
    49	# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
    50	#
    51	# Exit codes:
    52	#   0  every rule OK
    53	#   1  any rule FAIL
    54	#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
    55	#
    56	# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
    57	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    58	# =============================================================================
    59	set -euo pipefail
    60	export LC_ALL=C
    61	
    62	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
    63	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
    64	
    65	RUN_DIR="" BATCH_DIR="" SUITE_FILE="" ARM_OPT="" JSON=false
    66	usage() { echo "took-effect.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    67	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    68	  case "$1" in
    69	    --run-dir)    RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    70	    --batch-dir)  BATCH_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    71	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    72	    --arm)        ARM_OPT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    73	    --json)       JSON=true; shift ;;
    74	    -h|--help)    sed -n '2,56p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    75	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    76	  esac
    77	done
    78	[[ -n "$SUITE_FILE" && -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || usage "missing or unreadable --suite-file"
    79	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" || -n "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "one of --run-dir or --batch-dir is required"
    80	[[ -z "$RUN_DIR" || -z "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "--run-dir and --batch-dir are exclusive"
    81	SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || usage "suite file does not parse"
    82	
    83	# ---- rule helpers: each sets EVID and returns 0 (OK) / 1 (FAIL) --------------------
    84	EVID=""
    85	argv_files() { local f; for f in "$R/meta"/phase-*.argv.json; do [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$f"; done; return 0; }
    86	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → path or empty
    87	  local f="$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
    88	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$R/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
    89	  [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s' "$f"; return 0
    90	}
    91	
    92	expected_labels() {  # the arm's phase set for this run's task type (pipeline-run.sh's plan)
    93	  local type kind
    94	  type="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
    95	  if [[ "$type" == review-catch ]]; then kind=review-catch; else kind=build; fi
    96	  jq -r -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --arg kind "$kind" \
    97	    --argjson tg "$(jq -c '.arm_toggles // {}' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" '
    98	    (if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end) as $dflt
    99	    | ($arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt) as $p0
   100	    | (if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end) as $p1
   101	    | (if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end) as $p2
   102	    | (if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end) as $p3
   103	    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
   104	        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += ["FIX" + (.fix | tostring)] else .out += [$n] end)
   105	    | .out | join(",")'
   106	}
   107	
   108	rule_no_dot_claude() {
   109	  if [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" || -e "$R/sandbox/CLAUDE.md" ]]; then EVID="sandbox has .claude/ or CLAUDE.md"; return 1; fi
   110	  EVID="sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md"
   111	}
   112	rule_no_system_prompt() {
   113	  local f n=0 hit=""
   114	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   115	    n=$((n + 1))
   116	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | index("--append-system-prompt-file") != null' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && hit="$hit $(basename "$f")"
   117	  done < <(argv_files)
   118	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   119	  [[ -z "$hit" ]] || { EVID="--append-system-prompt-file in$hit"; return 1; }
   120	  EVID="no --append-system-prompt-file in $n argv"
   121	}
   122	rule_no_audit_rows() {
   123	  [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl" ]] && { EVID="sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl exists"; return 1; }
   124	  EVID="no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl"
   125	}
   126	rule_all_phases_present() {
   127	  local want got st
   128	  want="$(expected_labels)"
   129	  got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   130	  st="$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   131	  if [[ "$got" == "$want" ]]; then EVID="phases $got"; return 0; fi
   132	  case "$st" in
   133	    cap_failure|agent_error|interrupted|running)
   134	      if [[ -n "$got" && ",$want," == ",$got,"* ]]; then EVID="phases $got (run stopped: $st; set $want)"; return 0; fi ;;
   135	  esac
   136	  EVID="phases ${got:-none}, want $want (status $st)"; return 1
   137	}
   138	rule_no_plan_phase() {
   139	  local n; n="$(jq '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN")] | length' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   140	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n PLAN record(s)"; return 1; }
   141	  EVID="no PLAN record"
   142	}
   143	rule_one_voice_planned() {
   144	  local g f v bad="" ev=""
   145	  for g in review audit; do
   146	    f="$(envelope "$g")"
   147	    if [[ -z "$f" ]]; then bad="$bad $g:missing"; continue; fi
   148	    v="$(jq -r 'if (.metadata.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .metadata.companion_voice.planned
   149	                elif (.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .companion_voice.planned else "absent" end | tostring' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo unreadable)"
   150	    ev="$ev $g:planned=$v"
   151	    [[ "$v" == false ]] || bad="$bad $g:planned=$v"
   152	  done
   153	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="companion_voice${bad}"; return 1; }
   154	  EVID="companion_voice${ev}"
   155	}
   156	rule_no_gate_phases() {
   157	  local got; got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" or .name == "AUDIT" or .name == "FIX") | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   158	  [[ -z "$got" ]] || { EVID="gate records $got"; return 1; }
   159	  EVID="no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record"
   160	}
   161	rule_enforce_env_false() {
   162	  local f n=0 bad=""
   163	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   164	    n=$((n + 1))
   165	    [[ "$(jq -r '.env.LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE // "unset"' "$f")" == false ]] || bad="$bad $(basename "$f" .argv.json)"
   166	  done < <(argv_files)
   167	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   168	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE not false in$bad"; return 1; }
   169	  EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false in $n/$n phase env"
   170	}
   171	rule_no_flatline_rows() {
   172	  local n=0
   173	  if [[ -f "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
   174	    n="$(jq -R -n '[inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")
   175	           | (.payload.calling_primitive // .calling_primitive // .agent // "") | select(test("^flatline"))] | length' \
   176	         "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl")"
   177	  fi
   178	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n flatline MODELINV row(s)"; return 1; }
   179	  [[ -f "$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md" ]] || { EVID="no flatline rows but no sandbox sprint.md"; return 1; }
   180	  EVID="no flatline MODELINV rows; sprint.md present"
   181	}
   182	rule_implementer_single_session() {
   183	  local ids n sid f bad=""
   184	  ids="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true and (.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX")) | .session_id]' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   185	  n="$(jq 'length' <<<"$ids")"
   186	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no implementer record"; return 1; }
   187	  [[ "$(jq '[.[] | select(. == null)] | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="an implementer record has no session_id"; return 1; }
   188	  [[ "$(jq 'unique | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 1 ]] || { EVID="implementer session ids $(jq -r 'unique | join(",")' <<<"$ids")"; return 1; }
   189	  sid="$(jq -r '.[0]' <<<"$ids")"
   190	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   191	    case "$(jq -r '.name' "$f")" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) ;; *) continue ;; esac
   192	    jq -e '.resume == null' "$f" >/dev/null && continue
   193	    jq -e --arg s "$sid" '.resume == $s and ((.argv | index("--resume")) as $i | $i != null and .argv[$i + 1] == $s)' "$f" >/dev/null \
   194	      || bad="$bad $(jq -r '.label' "$f")"
   195	  done < <(argv_files)
   196	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="continuation argv does not resume $sid:$bad"; return 1; }
   197	  EVID="one session $sid across $n implementer record(s)"
   198	}
   199	rule_gates_separate_sessions() {
   200	  local r a impl
   201	  r="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   202	  a="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "AUDIT" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   203	  impl="$(jq -c '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX") | .session_id | select(. != null)] | unique' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   204	  [[ "$r" != null && "$a" != null ]] || { EVID="gate session ids review=$r audit=$a"; return 1; }
   205	  [[ "$r" != "$a" ]] || { EVID="REVIEW and AUDIT share session $r"; return 1; }
   206	  if jq -e --arg r "$r" --arg a "$a" 'index($r) != null or index($a) != null' <<<"$impl" >/dev/null; then
   207	    EVID="a gate shares an implementer session"; return 1
   208	  fi
   209	  EVID="review $r, audit $a, implementer $(jq -r 'join(",")' <<<"$impl")"
   210	}
   211	rule_effort_flag_medium() {
   212	  local f n=0 ok=0
   213	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   214	    n=$((n + 1))
   215	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | (index("--effort")) as $i | $i != null and .[$i + 1] == "medium"' "$f" >/dev/null && ok=$((ok + 1))
   216	  done < <(argv_files)
   217	  [[ $n -gt 0 && $ok -eq $n ]] || { EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"; return 1; }
   218	  EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"
   219	}
   220	rule_skill_effort_stripped() {
   221	  local f n=0 hit=0
   222	  for f in "$R"/sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
   223	    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
   224	    n=$((n + 1))
   225	    # the YAML frontmatter only (first line `---` to the next `---`); a body line may say effort:
   226	    awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" {exit} NR > 1 && $0 == "---" {exit} NR > 1 && /^effort:/ {hit = 1; exit} END {exit !hit}' "$f" \
   227	      && hit=$((hit + 1))
   228	  done
   229	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no sandbox SKILL.md"; return 1; }
   230	  [[ $hit -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$hit/$n SKILL.md still carry effort:"; return 1; }
   231	  EVID="skill effort lines stripped $n/$n"
   232	}
   233	rule_integrity_clean() {
   234	  local man="$R/sandbox/.claude/checksums.json" msha out
   235	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.arm_toggles.loa_mount' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" == false ]]; then
   236	    [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" ]] && { EVID="loa_mount: false but sandbox has .claude/"; return 1; }
   237	    EVID="no mount (loa_mount: false)"; return 0
   238	  fi
   239	  msha="$(jq -r '.arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 // empty' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   240	  [[ -n "$msha" && "$msha" != none ]] || { EVID="no arm_evidence.manifest_sha256"; return 1; }
   241	  [[ -f "$man" ]] && jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$man" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { EVID="no sandbox .claude/checksums.json files map"; return 1; }
   242	  # one hashlib walk over every manifest entry: "<n> <tampered> <missing> <file-sha> <first problem>"
   243	  out="$(python3 -I -c '
   244	import hashlib, json, os, sys
   245	root, man = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   246	def sha(p):
   247	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   248	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
   249	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
   250	            h.update(b)
   251	    return h.hexdigest()
   252	files = json.load(open(man)).get("files") or {}
   253	bad = missing = 0; first = "-"
   254	for rel, want in sorted(files.items()):
   255	    p = os.path.join(root, rel)
   256	    if not os.path.isfile(p):
   257	        missing += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "missing " + rel
   258	    elif sha(p) != want:
   259	        bad += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "tampered " + rel
   260	print(len(files), bad, missing, sha(man), first)' "$R/sandbox" "$man")" || { EVID="hash walk failed"; return 1; }
   261	  local n bad missing filesha first
   262	  read -r n bad missing filesha first <<<"$out"
   263	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="manifest lists no files"; return 1; }
   264	  if [[ "$bad" -gt 0 || "$missing" -gt 0 ]]; then EVID="$bad tampered, $missing missing of $n ($first)"; return 1; fi
   265	  EVID="$n manifest entries verified; manifest_sha256 ${msha:0:12}"
   266	  [[ "$filesha" == "$msha" ]] && EVID="$EVID (matches checksums.json)"
   267	  return 0
   268	}
   269	rule_applicability_refused() {
   270	  local f="$R/meta/refused.json" a t
   271	  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then
   272	    # a run that was not refused: its task type must be one the arm declares
   273	    t="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   274	    local k=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && k=review-catch
   275	    if jq -e --arg k "$k" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   276	         <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   277	      EVID="applicable: $t in task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") (no refusal needed)"; return 0
   278	    fi
   279	    EVID="ran on $t outside task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") without a refusal record"; return 1
   280	  fi
   281	  a="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$f")"; t="$(jq -r '.type // ""' "$f")"
   282	  [[ "$a" == "$ARM" && -n "$t" ]] || { EVID="refusal record names arm '$a' type '$t'"; return 1; }
   283	  local kind=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && kind=review-catch
   284	  if jq -e --arg k "$kind" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   285	       <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   286	    EVID="arm task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF") include $t, yet the run was refused"; return 1
   287	  fi
   288	  EVID="refused $t (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
   289	}

   291	# ---- one run ------------------------------------------------------------------------
   292	check_run() {  # check_run <run-dir> → prints lines; returns 0/1; 2 on usage problems
   293	  R="$1"
   294	  local arm rules rule fails=0 total=0 results='[]' ok
   295	  if [[ -n "$ARM_OPT" ]]; then arm="$ARM_OPT"
   296	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/arm" ]]; then arm="$(sed -n '1p' "$R/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
   297	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/refused.json")"
   298	  else arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
   299	  [[ -n "$arm" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no arm for $R" >&2; return 2; }
   300	  ARM="$arm"
   301	  ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$arm" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
   302	  [[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm is not declared in the suite" >&2; return 2; }
   303	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]]; then
   304	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: true, absent: true, rules: []}'
   305	    else printf 'arm %s: absent (component-absent; no rules)\n' "$arm"; fi
   306	    return 0
   307	  fi
   308	  if [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 258 Tasks 1.7 + 1.12
# (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6; sprint.md AC-1.7, AC-1.12, AC-1.14; PRD AC-4.x)
#
# evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh drives Loa's phases as separate CLI sessions in a
# sandbox repository. Here the CLI is evals/tests/fixtures/claude-stub-pipeline.sh,
# docker is fixtures/docker-stub.sh, and the executor runs from a temporary copy of
# the harness (make_harness) whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is fixtures/mount-lib-stub.sh:
# the shipped script sources its library by a literal path only (eval.yml trust
# boundary), so there is no environment override to point. The executor runs the CLI under
# `env -i`, which strips the stubs' control variables, so each test reaches the
# stubs through generated wrappers ($T/claude, $T/docker) that first record the
# environment and descriptors the executor gave them, then load $T/stub.env.
# =============================================================================

setup() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  FP="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/fingerprint.sh"
  STUB="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/claude-stub-pipeline.sh"
  DSTUB="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/docker-stub.sh"
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pr.XXXXXX")"
  export LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S=0.1
  export LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON='{"global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5":{"input_per_mtok":4000000,"output_per_mtok":20000000},"global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1":{"input_per_mtok":10000000,"output_per_mtok":50000000}}'
  export LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME="$T/home"
  : > "$T/stub.env"
  make_harness
  make_source_tree
  cp "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation-runs/suite.yaml" "$T/suite.yaml"   # B's suite file as landed
  make_tasks
  make_wrappers
}

teardown() {
  chmod -R u+rwx "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

make_source_tree() {
  local s
  mkdir -p "$T/src/.claude/loa" "$T/src/.claude/scripts"
  for s in planning-sprints implementing-tasks reviewing-code auditing-security; do
    mkdir -p "$T/src/.claude/skills/$s"
    printf -- '---\nname: %s\neffort: xhigh\n---\nbody\n' "$s" > "$T/src/.claude/skills/$s/SKILL.md"
  done
  echo "loa" > "$T/src/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
  printf 'flatline_protocol:\n  enabled: true\n  code_review:\n    enabled: true\n  security_audit:\n    enabled: true\n' > "$T/src/.loa.config.yaml"
  ( cd "$T/src" && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -qm init )
  # the operator's credential directories (copied per run in container mode)
  mkdir -p "$T/home/.aws" "$T/home/.claude/projects/big" "$T/home/.codex/sessions"
  echo "[default]" > "$T/home/.aws/config"
  echo "{}" > "$T/home/.claude/settings.json"
  echo "history" > "$T/home/.claude/history.jsonl"
  echo "{}" > "$T/home/.codex/auth.json"
  echo "model = 'x'" > "$T/home/.codex/config.toml"
  echo '{"claudeAiOauth": "subscription"}' > "$T/home/.claude/.credentials.json"
}

# a temporary copy of the harness: the stub mount library sits at the literal path
# pipeline-run.sh sources (lib/sandbox-mount.sh)
make_harness() {
  H="$T/h/evals/harness"
  mkdir -p "$H/lib"
  cp "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh" "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/fingerprint.sh" "$H/"
  cp -a "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts" "$H/lib/"
  cp "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/mount-lib-stub.sh" "$H/lib/sandbox-mount.sh"
  PR="$H/pipeline-run.sh"
}

make_tasks() {
  # build task: fixture tree beside a sibling hidden/ directory that must never be copied
  local b="$T/suite/tasks/bf-01" r="$T/suite/tasks/rc-01" p="$T/prs/pr-x"
  mkdir -p "$b/fx/src" "$b/hidden/tests"
  echo 'print(1)' > "$b/fx/src/app.py"
  echo 'assert False' > "$b/hidden/tests/test_secret.py"
  printf 'Make the app print two.\n' > "$b/TASK.md"
  cat > "$b/task.yaml" <<'YAML'
id: bf-01
schema_version: 1
type: bug-fix
fixture: fx
criterion: "the app prints two"
test_command: ["python3", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "tests"]
YAML
  # review-catch task: a PR fixture outside the task dir
  mkdir -p "$p/base/lib" "$p/head/lib" "$r"
  echo 'a=1' > "$p/base/lib/x.sh"; echo 'a=2' > "$p/head/lib/x.sh"
  printf -- '--- a/lib/x.sh\n+++ b/lib/x.sh\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-a=1\n+a=2\n' > "$p/head.diff"
  printf '# PR\nChange a.\n' > "$p/PR.md"
  printf '# Review instructions\nReview it.\n' > "$p/REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md"
  printf '# Audit instructions\nAudit it.\n' > "$p/AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md"
  printf 'name: pr-x\ndescription: "planted defects live elsewhere"\n' > "$p/fixture.yaml"
  printf 'Review the pull request in pr/.\n' > "$r/TASK.md"
  cat > "$r/task.yaml" <<YAML
id: rc-01
schema_version: 1
type: review-catch
fixture: null
criterion: "review the change"
review_catch: {fixture: "$p"}
YAML
  BUILD="$b/task.yaml" REVIEWC="$r/task.yaml"
}

make_wrappers() {
  mkdir -p "$T/log" "$T/dlog"
  cat > "$T/claude" <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
env | sed -E 's/^(AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK)=.*/\1=<set>/' > "$T/log/pending.env"   # key name only, never the value
if [[ -n "\${AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK:-}" ]]; then
  if [[ "\$AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK" == "\$(cat "$T/token" 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then echo match; else echo mismatch; fi >> "$T/log/token.check"
fi
ls "/proc/\$\$/fd" > "$T/log/pending.fds" 2>/dev/null || true
set -a; . "$T/stub.env"; set +a
export STUB_LOG_DIR="$T/log"
exec "$STUB" "\$@"
EOF
  cat > "$T/docker" <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
export DOCKER_STUB_LOG="$T/dlog" DOCKER_STUB_CLAUDE="$T/claude"
[[ -f "$T/docker.env" ]] && { set -a; . "$T/docker.env"; set +a; }
exec "$DSTUB" "\$@"
EOF
  chmod +x "$T/claude" "$T/docker"
}

# run_pr <arm> [task-yaml] [extra args…] — host executor unless --executor given
run_pr() {
  local arm="$1" task="${2:-$BUILD}"; shift; [[ $# -gt 0 ]] && shift
  run "$PR" --task-yaml "$task" --arm "$arm" --run-dir "$T/run" --run-id "r-$arm" --trial 1 \
    --source-tree "$T/src" --suite-file "$T/suite.yaml" --executor host --claude-bin "$T/claude" "$@"
}
labels() { jq -r '[.phases[] | .label] | join(",")' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json"; }
ran()    { jq -r '[.phases[] | select(.skipped == false) | .label] | join(",")' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json"; }
argv_of() { tr '\0' '\n' < "$T/log/call-$1.argv"; }   # argv_of <n>
call_for() { grep -lx "$1" "$T"/log/call-*.phase | sed -n '1p' | sed 's/.*call-\([0-9]*\)\.phase/\1/'; }

# --- plan -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  [ "$(sort -u "$T"/log/call-*.pwd)" = "$T/run/sandbox" ]
}

# --- cap and watchdog (D-4.6, D-4.10, AC-1.14) ----------------------------------------------------

@test "cap: the phase whose result cost passes USD 12 stops the run (cap_failure, cap_phase, exit 3)" {
  printf 'STUB_COST_PLAN=0.5\nSTUB_COST_IMPLEMENT=11.6\n' > "$T/stub.env"
  run_pr a1_full
  [ "$status" -eq 3 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.status + " " + .cap_phase' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json")" = "cap_failure IMPLEMENT" ]
  [ "$(labels)" = "PLAN,IMPLEMENT" ]
}

@test "cap: sandbox cost-ledger rows written during a phase count toward the cap" {
  printf 'STUB_COST_PLAN=0.5\nSTUB_COST_IMPLEMENT=6\nSTUB_LEDGER_USD_REVIEW=5.6\n' > "$T/stub.env"
  run_pr a1_full
  [ "$status" -eq 3 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.cap_phase' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json")" = REVIEW ]
  [ "$(jq -r '[.phases[] | select(.label == "REVIEW")][0].ledger_cost_usd' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json")" = 5.6 ]
  [ -s "$T/run/eval/cost-ledger.jsonl" ] && [ -s "$T/run/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]
}

@test "cap: --max-run-usd lowers the cap" {
  printf 'STUB_COST_PLAN=1.5\n' > "$T/stub.env"
  run_pr a1_full "$BUILD" --max-run-usd 1
  [ "$status" -eq 3 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.cap_phase + " " + (.max_run_usd | tostring)' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json")" = "PLAN 1" ]
}

@test "watchdog: priced turns that would pass the cap SIGTERM the phase and record cap_turn" {
  # Opus at USD 4 / 20 per Mtok: 200,000 output tokens a turn = USD 4.00004; after PLAN
  # (USD 0.5) the budget is 11.5, so the third turn crosses it.
  printf 'STUB_COST_PLAN=0.5\nSTUB_TURNS_IMPLEMENT=12\nSTUB_TURN_OUT_IMPLEMENT=200000\nSTUB_TURN_SLEEP=0.3\n' > "$T/stub.env"
  run_pr a1_full
  [ "$status" -eq 3 ]
  local p="$T/run/meta/pipeline.json"
  [ "$(jq -r '.status + " " + .cap_phase + " " + (.cap_turn | tostring)' "$p")" = "cap_failure IMPLEMENT 3" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '[.phases[] | select(.label == "IMPLEMENT")][0].watchdog | "\(.killed) \(.cap_turn)"' "$p")" = "true 3" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '[.phases[] | select(.label == "IMPLEMENT")][0].cost_source' "$p")" = watchdog_estimate ]
  # the phase was stopped before it finished its twelve turns
  [ "$(grep -c '"type":"assistant"' "$T/run/transcripts/events-IMPLEMENT.jsonl")" -lt 12 ]
}

@test "watchdog: turns under the cap leave the phase alone" {
  printf 'STUB_TURNS_IMPLEMENT=4\nSTUB_TURN_OUT_IMPLEMENT=1000\n' > "$T/stub.env"
  run_pr a1_full
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '[.phases[] | select(.label == "IMPLEMENT")][0].watchdog | "\(.killed) \(.priced)"' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json")" = "false true" ]
}

# --- failure classes (D-4.6, DEC-0405) ---------------------------------------------------------

@test "interrupted: SIGTERM to the driver mid-phase → exit 4, status interrupted, no grade.json" {
  printf 'STUB_SLEEP_IMPLEMENT=30\n' > "$T/stub.env"
  "$PR" --task-yaml "$BUILD" --arm a1_full --run-dir "$T/run" --run-id r1 --trial 1 --source-tree "$T/src" \
    --suite-file "$T/suite.yaml" --executor host --claude-bin "$T/claude" > "$T/out" 2>&1 &
  local pid=$! n=0
  while [ ! -e "$T/run/meta/phase-IMPLEMENT.argv.json" ] && [ $n -lt 100 ]; do sleep 0.1; n=$((n + 1)); done
  sleep 0.5
  kill -TERM "$pid"
  local rc=0; wait "$pid" || rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -eq 4 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.status' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json")" = interrupted ]
  [ ! -e "$T/run/grade.json" ] && [ ! -e "$T/run/meta/grade.json" ]
  [ "$(labels)" = "PLAN,IMPLEMENT" ]
}

@test "interrupted: a phase killed from outside (the CLI gets SIGTERM) → exit 4" {
  printf 'STUB_SELF_KILL_IMPLEMENT=1\n' > "$T/stub.env"
  run_pr a1_full
  [ "$status" -eq 4 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.status' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json")" = interrupted ]
}

@test "agent_error: a phase exiting non-zero stops the run (exit 1) with the record written" {
  printf 'STUB_EXIT_IMPLEMENT=3\n' > "$T/stub.env"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# execute-agent.sh — agent-execution step for Loa Eval Sandbox trials
#
# cycle-124 Sprint 3 (PRD FR-9 / SDD §3.6). Fills the slot at the top of the
# grading step in run-eval.sh: a task that declares `.agent.skill` runs the
# headless Claude CLI inside the sandbox before its graders; every other task
# takes the pre-existing path untouched.
#
# What it does, in order:
#   1. Gate: no `.agent.skill` in the task YAML → exit 3, nothing written.
#   2. Materialize the prompt surface from $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE into the sandbox:
#        <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/        (SKILL.md + resources/)
#        <ws>/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md      (+ .claude/rules/)
#        <ws>/CLAUDE.md                      → "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
#        <ws>/.eval/skill-prompt.md          (SKILL.md body, frontmatter stripped)
#      The prompt tree is the ONLY thing that differs between A/B arms, so it
#      is recorded: prompt_tree_sha = `git rev-parse HEAD:.claude` of the tree,
#      prompt_tree_commit, and whether .claude/ had uncommitted changes.
#   3. Run:  claude -p "<task.prompt>" --output-format stream-json --verbose
#              --model $EVAL_MODEL [--effort <e>] --restricted --tools Read,Grep,Glob,Write
#              --permission-mode acceptEdits --append-system-prompt-file <skill-prompt>
#              --max-turns $EVAL_MAX_TURNS
#      --restricted --tools names the SDD's fixed tool set EXACTLY: it removes the
#      code-running tools, ignores the operator's user/project/local settings (their
#      Bash(...) allow rules leaked into the sprint-237 A/B arms under --allowed-tools,
#      which only adds rules) and confines Read/Grep/Glob/Write to the sandbox.
#      Edit/MultiEdit are therefore unavailable; the transcript extractor below still
#      records them defensively.
#      cwd = sandbox; env-isolated (LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH / LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH and
#      TMPDIR into the sandbox; GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/OPENAI_API_KEY/AWS_* unset;
#      HOME and PATH stay so the CLI finds its own credentials and toolchain).
#   4. Record <ws>/.eval/events.jsonl (raw stream), agent-output.json (the
#      `result` event) and executor.json:
#        {schema_version, skill, model_requested, model_id (the id the CLI
#         echoed — the modelUsage entry with the most output tokens), effort,
#         prompt_tree_sha, prompt_tree_commit, prompt_tree_dirty, exit_code,
#         is_error, duration_ms, num_turns, total_cost_usd, usage{…},
#         tool_writes:[{seq,tool,path}] in transcript order}
#
# Exit codes:
#   0  agent ran (its own verdict is the graders' business)
#   1  the CLI exited non-zero or timed out (executor.json still written)
#   2  infrastructure error (CLI binary missing, prompt tree lacks the skill)
#   3  task declares no agent (caller should not have called us)
#
# Env:
#   EVAL_MODEL          model passed to --model            (default claude-sonnet-5)
#   EVAL_EFFORT         override effort                    (default: task/skill)
#   EVAL_PROMPT_TREE    repo whose .claude/ is materialized (default: this repo)
#   EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN     CLI executable                     (default: claude)
#   EVAL_MAX_TURNS      --max-turns                        (default 40)
#
# Control arms (cycle-129 FR-2, SDD D-2.1):
#   LOA_EVAL_ARM          arm id (default baseline). Setting it at all is "arm
#                         mode": the prompt tree's .loa.config.yaml is also
#                         materialised so every arm sees the same config.
#   LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES  JSON object {toggle: false, …}; when unset the arm is
#                         resolved from LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, else from
#                         evals/suites/<task dir name>.yaml (`ab.arms[]`)
  case "$1" in
    --task-yaml) TASK_YAML="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --workspace) WORKSPACE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --run-id) RUN_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --trial-id) TRIAL_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --timeout) TIMEOUT_S="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --help|-h) usage ;;
    *) echo "ERROR: Unknown option: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" && -n "$WORKSPACE" ]] || { echo "ERROR: --task-yaml and --workspace are required" >&2; exit 2; }
[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || { echo "ERROR: task YAML not found: $TASK_YAML" >&2; exit 2; }
[[ -d "$WORKSPACE" ]] || { echo "ERROR: workspace not found: $WORKSPACE" >&2; exit 2; }
WORKSPACE="$(cd "$WORKSPACE" && pwd)"

# --- 1. gate ---------------------------------------------------------------
skill="$(yq -r '.agent.skill // ""' "$TASK_YAML")"
if [[ -z "$skill" || "$skill" == "null" ]]; then
  echo "execute-agent: task declares no .agent.skill — nothing to run" >&2
  exit 3
fi
case "$skill" in
  */*|.*|'') echo "ERROR: invalid skill name '$skill'" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

PROMPT_TREE="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$REPO_ROOT}"
PROMPT_TREE="$(cd "$PROMPT_TREE" && pwd)"
CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
MODEL="${EVAL_MODEL:-claude-sonnet-5}"
MAX_TURNS="${EVAL_MAX_TURNS:-40}"

skill_src="$PROMPT_TREE/.claude/skills/$skill"
[[ -f "$skill_src/SKILL.md" ]] || { echo "ERROR: prompt tree $PROMPT_TREE has no .claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v "$CLAUDE_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [[ -x "$CLAUDE_BIN" ]] || { echo "ERROR: CLI not found: $CLAUDE_BIN (set EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN)" >&2; exit 2; }

# --- 2. materialize ----------------------------------------------------------
# The materialisation and toggle functions live in lib/sandbox-mount.sh (cycle-130
# Task 1.6, shared with pipeline-run.sh); the arm is resolved first because
# loa_mount: false skips the prompt surface entirely.
eval_dir="$WORKSPACE/.eval"
mkdir -p "$eval_dir"

# --- 2b. control arm (cycle-129 FR-2) -----------------------------------------
ARM_MODE=false
[[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM+x}" ]] && ARM_MODE=true
ARM="${LOA_EVAL_ARM:-baseline}"
[[ "$ARM" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { echo "ERROR: invalid LOA_EVAL_ARM '$ARM'" >&2; exit 2; }

# The arm's toggles: explicit JSON, else the suite's arms[] / ab.arms[] entry.
resolve_toggles() {
  # audit r1 DISS-C-001: toggles exist only in arm mode (LOA_EVAL_ARM set); a stale
  # LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES in a non-arm environment is ignored, and the baseline arm
  # never carries toggles.
  if [[ "$ARM_MODE" != "true" ]]; then
    [[ -z "${LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES:-}" ]] || echo "WARN: LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES is set but LOA_EVAL_ARM is not: ignored (not an arm run)" >&2
    printf '{}'; return 0
  fi
  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES:-}" ]]; then
    jq -ce 'if type == "object" then . else error("not an object") end' <<<"$LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES" 2>/dev/null \
      || { echo "ERROR: LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES is not a JSON object" >&2; return 2; }
    if [[ "$ARM" == "baseline" && "$(jq -c 'length' <<<"$LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES")" != "0" ]]; then
      echo "ERROR: the baseline arm takes no toggles (LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES=$LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES)" >&2; return 2
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  local suite_file="${LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE:-}"
  if [[ -z "$suite_file" ]]; then
    local tdir; tdir="$(basename "$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")")"
    [[ -f "$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/$tdir.yaml" ]] && suite_file="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/$tdir.yaml"
  fi
  resolve_arm_toggles "$ARM" "$suite_file"
}
ARM_TOGGLES="$(resolve_toggles)" || exit 2

# cycle-130: sprint_plan and context_resets edit the phase set of the pipeline
# executor; the single-skill path has no phases, so they cannot take effect here.
for k in sprint_plan context_resets; do
  if [[ "$(K="$k" jq -r 'has(env.K)' <<<"$ARM_TOGGLES")" == "true" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: arm '$ARM' toggle $k applies to the pipeline executor (pipeline-run.sh) only" >&2; exit 2
  fi

    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --arm)            ARM="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --run-dir|--workspace) RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;

_SM_LIB_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
_SM_REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$_SM_LIB_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"

_sm_err() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; }

# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
# hashes the corpus the same way.
_sm_sha256() {
  python3 -I -c '
import hashlib, sys
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(b)
    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
}

# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
_sm_evidence() {
  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
  else
    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
  fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Remove the markdown section that starts at the exact heading line $2 (up to
# the next level-2 heading) from file $1. Prints the number of lines removed.
_sm_drop_md_section() {
  local f="$1" heading="$2" tmpdir="$3" tmp
  tmp="$(mktemp "$tmpdir/.arm.XXXXXX")"
  awk -v h="$heading" '
    $0 == h { skip = 1; n++; next }
    skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
    skip { n++; next }
    { print }
    END { print n + 0 > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
  mv "$tmp" "$f"
  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
}

# Remove the first blank-line-delimited paragraph of $1 that contains one of
# the needles (tried in order, case-insensitive). Writes the removed text to
# $2; exit 1 when no needle matches.
_sm_drop_paragraph() {
  python3 -I - "$1" "$2" "look for what the review did not" "Confirm the review's demotions independently" <<'PY'
import re, sys
path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
paras = re.split(r"(\n[ \t]*\n)", text)
for needle in sys.argv[3:]:
    for i in range(0, len(paras), 2):
        if needle.lower() in paras[i].lower():
            removed = paras[i]
            # drop the paragraph and the separator that follows it
            del paras[i:i + 2]
            open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("".join(paras))
            open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(removed + "\n")
            sys.exit(0)
sys.exit(1)
PY
}

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# freeze.sh — cycle-130 ablation suite freeze (SDD §5.13, DEC-0404, DEC-0414)
     4	#
     5	# Writes or verifies <root>/MANIFEST.sha256, the suite's frozen identity: one
     6	# "<sha256>  <relpath>" line per file under <root>/tasks/ (and <root>/smoke/
     7	# with --smoke), relpath relative to the root, LC_ALL=C sorted, sha256 (Python
     8	# hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code, eval.yml trust boundary).
     9	# validate-suite.sh runs first; an invalid suite is never frozen or accepted.
    10	#
    11	# Usage:
    12	#   freeze.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--check] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
    13	#
    14	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
    15	#   --smoke           cover smoke/ too (passed to the validator as well)
    16	#   --check           recompute and compare with MANIFEST.sha256; write nothing
    17	#   --allow-partial   passed to validate-suite.sh (fewer than four tasks per type)
    18	#   --suite-file F    passed to validate-suite.sh
    19	#
    20	# Output: `freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 (N files, sha256 <digest of the manifest>)`
    21	# or `freeze: OK — N files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 …)`; on drift every
    22	# changed / added / removed path on its own line.
    23	#
    24	# Exit: 0 written / matches; 1 drift, missing manifest under --check, or the
    25	#       validator found violations; 2 usage.
    26	# Tested by evals/tests/freeze.bats.
    27	# =============================================================================
    28	set -euo pipefail
    29	export LC_ALL=C
    30	
    31	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    32	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    33	
    34	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    35	CHECK=false SMOKE=false
    36	VARGS=()
    37	
    38	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,26p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    39	die() { echo "freeze: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    40	
    41	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    42	  case "$1" in
    43	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    44	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; VARGS+=(--smoke); shift ;;
    45	    --check) CHECK=true; shift ;;
    46	    --allow-partial) VARGS+=(--allow-partial); shift ;;
    47	    --suite-file) [[ -n "${2:-}" ]] || die "--suite-file needs a path"; VARGS+=(--suite-file "$2"); shift 2 ;;
    48	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    49	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    50	  esac
    51	done
    52	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
    53	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    54	MANIFEST="$ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256"
    55	
    56	vrc=0
    57	"$SCRIPT_DIR/validate-suite.sh" --root "$ROOT" ${VARGS[@]+"${VARGS[@]}"} || vrc=$?
    58	if [[ $vrc -eq 1 ]]; then echo "freeze: refused — the suite does not validate" >&2; exit 1; fi
    59	[[ $vrc -eq 0 ]] || die "validate-suite.sh failed (exit $vrc)"
    60	
    61	# compute_manifest <out> — the manifest body for the current tree.
    62	compute_manifest() {
    63	  local out="$1" list dirs=(tasks)
    64	  [[ "$SMOKE" == "true" ]] && dirs+=(smoke)
    65	  list="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze-list.XXXXXX")"
    66	  local d
    67	  for d in "${dirs[@]}"; do
    68	    [[ -d "$ROOT/$d" ]] || continue
    69	    ( cd "$ROOT" && find "$d" -type f -print )
    70	  done | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
    71	  if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then rm -f "$list"; die "a path under the suite holds a backslash"; fi
    72	  python3 -I - "$ROOT" "$list" > "$out" <<'PY' || { rm -f "$list"; die "hashing failed"; }
    73	import hashlib, os, sys
    74	root, listing = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    75	for rel in open(listing, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
    76	    if not rel:
    77	        continue
    78	    h = hashlib.sha256()
    79	    with open(os.path.join(root, rel), "rb") as f:
    80	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
    81	            h.update(b)
    82	    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + rel)
    83	PY
    84	  rm -f "$list"
    85	}
    86	digest_of() { python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$1"; }
    87	
    88	TMP="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze.XXXXXX")"
    89	trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
    90	compute_manifest "$TMP"
    91	n="$(grep -c . "$TMP" || true)"
    92	
    93	if [[ "$CHECK" == "true" ]]; then
    94	  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || { echo "freeze: no MANIFEST.sha256 in $ROOT (run freeze.sh first)" >&2; exit 1; }
    95	  if cmp -s "$TMP" "$MANIFEST"; then
    96	    echo "freeze: OK — $n files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"
    97	    exit 0
    98	  fi
    99	  echo "freeze: DRIFT against $MANIFEST:"
   100	  python3 -I - "$MANIFEST" "$TMP" <<'PY'
   101	import sys
   102	def load(p):
   103	    m = {}
   104	    for line in open(p, encoding="utf-8"):
   105	        line = line.rstrip("\n")
   106	        if line:
   107	            h, _, rel = line.partition("  ")
   108	            m[rel] = h
   109	    return m
   110	old, new = load(sys.argv[1]), load(sys.argv[2])
   111	for rel in sorted(set(old) | set(new)):
   112	    if rel not in new:
   113	        print(f"  removed  {rel}")
   114	    elif rel not in old:
   115	        print(f"  added    {rel}")
   116	    elif old[rel] != new[rel]:
   117	        print(f"  changed  {rel}")
   118	PY
   119	  exit 1
   120	fi
   121	
   122	cp "$TMP" "$MANIFEST.tmp" && mv "$MANIFEST.tmp" "$MANIFEST"
   123	echo "freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 ($n files, sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"
   124	exit 0

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# fingerprint.sh — toolchain fingerprint for ablation runs (cycle-130 FR-4, SDD A11 / DEC-0389)
     4	#
     5	# Prints `fp:<sha256>` over the LC_ALL=C-sorted `tool=version` lines of the
     6	# toolchain an ablation run depends on (claude, codex, python3, node, yq, jq,
     7	# bats, git, docker) plus `source_tree=<HEAD of --source-tree>`. A tool that is
     8	# not installed reads `tool=absent`, so a missing tool changes the fingerprint
     9	# instead of failing the run. The value fills `image_digest` in host mode and
    10	# `fingerprint` in every mode (MANIFEST.json, pipeline.json, runs.jsonl). It reads the
    11	# HOST toolchain: in container mode the phases run on the image's toolchain, and the
    12	# image digest (not this value) identifies the batch's versions (on 2026-10-15 the host
    13	# CLI was 2.1.300 while Dockerfile.ablation pins 2.1.299).
    14	#
    15	# Usage:
    16	#   fingerprint.sh [--source-tree DIR] [--claude-bin B] [--bats-bin B] [--json]
    17	#
    18	# Options:
    19	#   --source-tree DIR  the pinned Loa tree; its `git rev-parse HEAD` is folded in
    20	#                      (`none` when absent or not a git tree)
    21	#   --claude-bin B     the CLI executable (default: $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
    22	#   --bats-bin B       bats executable (default: bats on PATH, else the operator's
    23	#                      ~/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats)
    24	#   --json             print {fingerprint, tools{}, source_tree, lines[]} instead
    25	#
    26	# Exit codes:
    27	#   0  printed
    28	#   2  usage error
    29	#
    30	# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (fingerprint cases).
    31	# =============================================================================
    32	set -euo pipefail
    33	export LC_ALL=C
    34	
    35	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
    36	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
    37	
    38	SOURCE_TREE=""
    39	CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
     3	# =============================================================================
     4	# tests/unit/gen-checksums.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 1 (PRD FR-1, AC-1.1/AC-1.2;
     5	# SDD §5.1). tools/gen-checksums.sh writes .claude/checksums.json from the
     6	# TRACKED .claude/ tree only: untracked build/cache/runtime artefacts
     7	# (__pycache__, .run/, node_modules) and .claude/overrides/ never enter it.
     8	# Every case runs on a fixture git repository built in setup(); the live
     9	# manifest is only read by GC-8.
    10	# =============================================================================
    11	
    12	setup() {
    13	  ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd -P)"
    14	  GEN="$ROOT/tools/gen-checksums.sh"
    15	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gencs.XXXXXX")"
    16	  R="$T/repo"
    17	  mkdir -p "$R/.claude/scripts/lib" "$R/.claude/overrides" "$R/.claude/scripts/__pycache__" \
    18	    "$R/.claude/.run" "$R/.claude/node_modules/pkg"
    19	  printf 'echo a\n' > "$R/.claude/scripts/a.sh"
    20	  printf 'echo c\n' > "$R/.claude/scripts/lib/c.sh"
    21	  printf 'doc\n' > "$R/.claude/README.md"
    22	  printf 'override\n' > "$R/.claude/overrides/o.md"
    23	  printf 'outside\n' > "$R/outside.txt"
    24	  # untracked artefacts that a working-tree walk would pick up
    25	  printf 'bytecode' > "$R/.claude/scripts/__pycache__/x.pyc"
    26	  printf 'lock' > "$R/.claude/.run/a.lock"
    27	  printf '{}' > "$R/.claude/node_modules/pkg/index.js"
    28	  git -C "$R" init --quiet
    29	  git -C "$R" -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null add .claude/scripts/a.sh .claude/scripts/lib/c.sh \
    30	    .claude/README.md .claude/overrides/o.md outside.txt
    31	  git -C "$R" -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null commit --quiet -m fixture
    32	}
    33	teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
    34	
    35	@test "GC-1 the manifest lists exactly the tracked non-override .claude files" {
    36	  run bash "$GEN" --root "$R"
    37	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    38	  run jq -r '.files | keys[]' "$R/.claude/checksums.json"
    39	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    40	  [ "$output" = $'.claude/README.md\n.claude/scripts/a.sh\n.claude/scripts/lib/c.sh' ]
    41	  [ "$(jq -r '.algorithm' "$R/.claude/checksums.json")" = "sha256" ]
    42	  [[ "$(jq -r '.generated' "$R/.claude/checksums.json")" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:]{8}Z$ ]]
    43	}
    44	
    45	@test "GC-2 hashes are sha256_portable digests of the working-tree content" {
    46	  bash "$GEN" --root "$R" 2>/dev/null
    47	  source "$ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    48	  expected="$(cd "$R" && sha256_portable .claude/scripts/a.sh | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    49	  [ "$(jq -r '.files[".claude/scripts/a.sh"]' "$R/.claude/checksums.json")" = "$expected" ]
    50	}
    51	
    52	@test "GC-3 two runs are byte-identical except generated" {
    53	  bash "$GEN" --root "$R" --out "$T/one.json" 2>/dev/null
    54	  sleep 1
    55	  bash "$GEN" --root "$R" --out "$T/two.json" 2>/dev/null
    56	  jq 'del(.generated)' "$T/one.json" > "$T/one.nogen"
    57	  jq 'del(.generated)' "$T/two.json" > "$T/two.nogen"
    58	  cmp "$T/one.nogen" "$T/two.nogen"
    59	  # the raw files differ on the generated line only
    60	  run diff <(grep -v '"generated"' "$T/one.json") <(grep -v '"generated"' "$T/two.json")
    61	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    62	}
    63	
    64	@test "GC-4 --check exits 0 right after generation" {
    65	  bash "$GEN" --root "$R" 2>/dev/null
    66	  run bash "$GEN" --root "$R" --check
    67	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    68	}
    69	
    70	@test "GC-5 --check exits 1 naming a changed tracked file" {
    71	  bash "$GEN" --root "$R" 2>/dev/null
    72	  printf 'echo changed\n' > "$R/.claude/scripts/a.sh"
    73	  run --separate-stderr bash "$GEN" --root "$R" --check
    74	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    75	  [[ "$stderr" == *"changed: .claude/scripts/a.sh"* ]]
    76	}
    77	
    78	@test "GC-6 --check exits 1 naming a deleted tracked file" {
    79	  bash "$GEN" --root "$R" 2>/dev/null
    80	  rm -f "$R/.claude/scripts/lib/c.sh"
    81	  run --separate-stderr bash "$GEN" --root "$R" --check
    82	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    83	  [[ "$stderr" == *"removed: .claude/scripts/lib/c.sh"* ]]
    84	}
    85	
    86	@test "GC-7 exit 2 outside a git repository and on a usage error" {
    87	  mkdir -p "$T/plain/.claude"
    88	  printf 'x\n' > "$T/plain/.claude/x.sh"
    89	  run --separate-stderr bash "$GEN" --root "$T/plain" --check
    90	  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
    91	  [[ "$stderr" == *"not a git work tree"* ]]
    92	  run bash "$GEN" --bogus
    93	  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
    94	}

# Copy of evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml as implementer B landed it (Sprint 258); the fixture runs and
# evals/tests/{pipeline-run,ablation-row,took-effect}.bats read this copy so the tests do not move with the live suite.
# =============================================================================
# evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml — cycle-130 Loa 2.0 component ablation suite
#
# SDD §3.3 (structure reproduced), extended by Sprint 258 Task 1.6: the
# tasks block with the smoke root, phase_defaults, phase_sets, cost_hint, each
# arm's phase-set override and took-effect rule ids, and the full pre-registered
# rules block (D-A5; mirrored in NOTES before the first run, DEC-0383).
#
# Readers: execute-agent.sh / lib/sandbox-mount.sh (arms[].toggles via
# resolve_arm_toggles), pipeline-run.sh (phase_defaults, phase_sets,
# arms[].phases, arms[].effort), took-effect.sh (arms[].took_effect),
# run-ablation.sh (trials, caps, priority, cut_ladder, arms[].task_types),
# ablation-report.py (rules), validate-suite.sh (arm ids for the leakage check,
# task_types against the known types).
#
# task_types: `all` | `build` (= feature-build, bug-fix, refactor) |
#   `review-catch` | a single build type. An arm is never scheduled, and a row
#   never reported, on a type outside its declaration (DEC-0400, DEC-0406).
# took_effect: rule ids took-effect.sh evaluates per trial (DEC-0418); a miss is
#   infrastructure_error and pauses the arm. `applicability_refused` is the
#   smoke's evidence line that the planner refused the arm on a review-catch task.
# =============================================================================
name: ablation-2.0
version: 1
source_commit: "<sprint-258-commit>"   # the lead sets the Sprint 258 commit (rc.5 plus the mount fix; F2, DEC-0392)
agy_opt_in: false
tasks:
  root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/tasks
  manifest: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/MANIFEST.sha256
  smoke_root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/smoke
suite_version: 1
trials: {build: 3, review-catch: 3}      # D-A4: review-catch trials 3, not 5, under the gate pipeline
cut_ladder: ["A5, A6, A7 not run", "A2 and A3 build trials 3 -> 2", "A3 review-catch trials 3 -> 2"]   # DEC-0397; A0, A1, A4 keep 3
caps: {cycle_usd: 1500, run_usd: 12, reserve_usd: 250}   # reserve released to A7 when the re-verification rule needs no run (DEC-0398)
priority: [a0_bare, a1_full, a2_no_sprint_plan, a3_one_voice, a4_no_gates, a7_effort_medium, a5_no_flatline, a6_one_window]
cost_hint: {build: 7, review-catch: 8}   # USD per run before any actual exists (run-arms/run-ablation est_next fallback)

# Session defaults per phase (SDD D-4.3). A6's continued session carries the
# caps of the phase it is in; A0's BARE caps are PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX.
phase_defaults:
  models:
    PLAN: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    IMPLEMENT: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    FIX: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    BARE: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    REVIEW: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
    AUDIT: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
  max_turns: {PLAN: 30, IMPLEMENT: 60, REVIEW: 40, FIX: 40, AUDIT: 40, BARE: 170}
  timeout_min: {PLAN: 15, IMPLEMENT: 25, REVIEW: 20, FIX: 15, AUDIT: 20, BARE: 70}
  tools: "Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"   # identical for every arm, A0 included
phase_sets:   # D-4.1: A1's phases per task type; FIX runs only after a CHANGES_REQUIRED gate
  review-catch: [REVIEW, AUDIT]
  build: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX]

arms:
  - {id: a0_bare, label: A0, task_types: [all], toggles: {loa_mount: false}, phases: [BARE], effort: high,
     took_effect: [no_dot_claude, no_system_prompt, no_audit_rows, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a1_full, label: A1, task_types: [all], toggles: {}, took_effect: [all_phases_present, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a2_no_sprint_plan, label: A2, task_types: [build], toggles: {sprint_plan: false},
     phases: [IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX],
     took_effect: [no_plan_phase, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a3_one_voice, label: A3, task_types: [all], toggles: {companion_voice: false}, took_effect: [one_voice_planned, integrity_clean]}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# regen.sh — rebuild the fixture run directories under runs/ (cycle-130 Sprint 258)
#
# Each fixture is a real evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh run (host executor) against
# the stub CLI (../claude-stub-pipeline.sh) and the stub mount library
# (../mount-lib-stub.sh), using suite.yaml and the tasks under tasks/. The sandbox's
# own .git and the snapshot bundles are dropped (no nested repositories in the
# tracked tree); absolute paths are rewritten to /fixture and /home/operator.
# grade.json files and MANIFEST.json are written here as Sprint 259's grader and
# run-ablation.sh would shape them (SDD §3.4, §3.6).
#
# Usage: evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/regen.sh
# Consumers: evals/tests/ablation-row.bats, evals/tests/took-effect.bats
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
FIX="$(cd "$HERE/.." && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$HERE/../../../.." && pwd)"
GEN="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/abl-fixture.XXXXXX")"
trap 'chmod -R u+rwx "$GEN" 2>/dev/null; find "$GEN" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null; rmdir "$GEN" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

# a temporary copy of the harness with the stub mount library at the literal path
# pipeline-run.sh sources (no environment override exists: eval.yml trust boundary)
H="$GEN/h/evals/harness"
mkdir -p "$H/lib"
cp "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh" "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/fingerprint.sh" "$H/"
cp -a "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts" "$H/lib/"
cp "$FIX/mount-lib-stub.sh" "$H/lib/sandbox-mount.sh"
PR="$H/pipeline-run.sh"

# the pinned source tree the mount is copied from (tiny stand-in)
mkdir -p "$GEN/src/.claude/loa"
for s in planning-sprints implementing-tasks reviewing-code auditing-security; do
  mkdir -p "$GEN/src/.claude/skills/$s"
  printf -- '---\nname: %s\neffort: xhigh\n---\nbody\n' "$s" > "$GEN/src/.claude/skills/$s/SKILL.md"
done
echo loa > "$GEN/src/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
printf 'flatline_protocol:\n  enabled: true\n  code_review:\n    enabled: true\n  security_audit:\n    enabled: true\n' > "$GEN/src/.loa.config.yaml"
( cd "$GEN/src" && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.email=f@f -c user.name=f -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm fixture )

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.4, AC-1.3)
     4	#
     5	# Proves that a FRESH downstream submodule mount of this repository passes
     6	# `check-loa.sh` integrity: no Tampered, no Missing (paths the mount does not
     7	# link by design are reported as not-mounted and do not fail).
     8	#
     9	# Steps, all inside a new temp directory (nothing outside it is written):
    10	#   1. upstream/   — a `git clone` of this repository over file://, with a
    11	#                    local branch `fresh-mount-proof` at REF. With --worktree
    12	#                    the source work tree's uncommitted state (tracked edits,
    13	#                    deletions and untracked non-ignored files) is copied in
    14	#                    and committed on that branch, inside the temp clone only.
    15	#   2. downstream/ — `git init`, one commit, then the downstream entry point
    16	#                    `upstream/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh --branch
    17	#                    fresh-mount-proof --ref <sha> --force` with
    18	#                    LOA_UPSTREAM=file://.../upstream (the mount clones the
    19	#                    submodule from there; no network).
    20	#   3. `aleph.enabled: false` is set in downstream/.loa.config.yaml.
    21	#   4. `bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh` runs in downstream/; its full output
    22	#      is printed, then a summary line
    23	#        fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=T Missing=M not-mounted=N check-loa-rc=R
    24	#
    25	# Git runs hermetically: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1,
    26	# a fixed identity, protocol.file.allow=always (needed for a file:// submodule
    27	# on git >= 2.38.1) and core.hooksPath pointed at an empty directory.
    28	#
    29	# Usage:
    30	#   tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh [--ref REF] [--worktree] [--keep] [--tmp DIR]
    31	#
    32	# Options:
    33	#   --ref REF    commit-ish of this repository to mount (default: HEAD of the
    34	#                repository the script lives in)
    35	#   --worktree   mount REF plus the source work tree's uncommitted state
    36	#                (use before the change is committed)
    37	#   --keep       keep the temp directory and print its path
    38	#   --tmp DIR    parent directory for the temp directory (default: $TMPDIR or
    39	#                /tmp)
    40	#   -h, --help   this text
    41	#
    42	# Exit codes:
    43	#   0    check-loa.sh exited 0 on the fresh mount
    44	#   1    check-loa.sh exited non-zero (its output names the failures)
    45	#   2    usage error
    46	#   3    setup failed (clone, overlay, downstream init or the mount itself);
    47	#        the failing step's output is printed
    48	# =============================================================================
    49	set -euo pipefail
    50	export LC_ALL=C
    51	
    52	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    53	die2() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    54	die3() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: SETUP FAILED: $*" >&2; exit 3; }
    55	
    56	REF=""
    57	KEEP=0
    58	WORKTREE=0
    59	TMP_PARENT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --ref)
    63	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--ref requires a commit-ish"
    64	      REF="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    65	    --tmp)
    66	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--tmp requires a directory"
    67	      TMP_PARENT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    68	    --keep) KEEP=1; shift ;;
    69	    --worktree) WORKTREE=1; shift ;;
    70	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    71	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    72	  esac
    73	done
    74	[[ -d "$TMP_PARENT" ]] || die2 "--tmp is not a directory: $TMP_PARENT"
    75	
    76	SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"
    77	SRC="$(git -C "$SELF_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "script is not inside a git work tree"
    78	[[ -n "$REF" ]] || REF="HEAD"
    79	REF_SHA="$(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${REF}^{commit}")" || die2 "not a commit in $SRC: $REF"
    80	
    81	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMP_PARENT%/}/fresh-mount-proof.XXXXXX")"
    82	cleanup() {
    83	  if [[ $KEEP -eq 1 ]]; then
    84	    echo "fresh-mount-proof: kept $WORK" >&2
    85	  else
    86	    rm -rf "$WORK"
    87	  fi
    88	}
    89	trap cleanup EXIT
    90	
    91	# --- hermetic git ---------------------------------------------------------------
    92	mkdir -p "$WORK/no-hooks"
    93	export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
    94	export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=3
    95	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=protocol.file.allow GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=always
    96	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=core.hooksPath GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1="$WORK/no-hooks"
    97	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2=init.defaultBranch GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2=main
    98	export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="fresh-mount-proof" GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="fresh-mount-proof@localhost"
    99	export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL"
   100	unset LOA_ALEPH_ENABLED
   101	
   102	LOG="$WORK/step.log"
   103	run_step() {  # run_step <description> <cmd...>; output to $LOG, printed on failure
   104	  local desc="$1"; shift
   105	  if ! "$@" > "$LOG" 2>&1; then
   106	    cat "$LOG" >&2
   107	    die3 "$desc"
   108	  fi
   109	}
   110	
   111	suffix=""
   112	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && suffix=" + work-tree state"
   113	echo "fresh-mount-proof: source $SRC at ${REF_SHA}${suffix}"
   114	echo "fresh-mount-proof: temp dir $WORK"
   115	
   116	# --- 1. upstream clone ----------------------------------------------------------
   117	UP="$WORK/upstream"
   118	run_step "clone $SRC" git clone --quiet --no-checkout "file://$SRC" "$UP"
   119	run_step "fetch $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" fetch --quiet origin "$REF_SHA"
   120	run_step "branch at $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" checkout --quiet -B fresh-mount-proof "$REF_SHA"
   121	
   122	overlay() {
   123	  local p
   124	  while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
   125	    if [[ -e "$SRC/$p" || -L "$SRC/$p" ]]; then
   126	      [[ -d "$SRC/$p" && ! -L "$SRC/$p" ]] && continue   # gitlink / nested repo
   127	      mkdir -p "$UP/$(dirname "$p")"
   128	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   129	      cp -P "$SRC/$p" "$UP/$p"
   130	    else
   131	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   132	    fi
   133	  done < <(git -C "$SRC" ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard)
   134	  git -C "$UP" add -A
   135	  git -C "$UP" commit --quiet --allow-empty -m "fresh-mount-proof: work-tree state of $SRC"
   136	}
   137	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && run_step "work-tree overlay" overlay
   138	MOUNT_SHA="$(git -C "$UP" rev-parse HEAD)"
   139	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mounting upstream commit $MOUNT_SHA"
   140	
   141	# --- 2. downstream repository and the submodule mount --------------------------
   142	DOWN="$WORK/downstream"
   143	mkdir -p "$DOWN"
   144	init_downstream() {
   145	  git -C "$DOWN" init --quiet
   146	  printf '# downstream fixture\n' > "$DOWN/README.md"
   147	  git -C "$DOWN" add README.md
   148	  git -C "$DOWN" commit --quiet -m "initial commit"
   149	}
   150	run_step "downstream init" init_downstream
   151	
   152	do_mount() {
   153	  (cd "$DOWN" && LOA_UPSTREAM="file://$UP" bash "$UP/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh" \
   154	    --branch fresh-mount-proof --ref "$MOUNT_SHA" --force < /dev/null)
   155	}
   156	run_step "mount-submodule.sh" do_mount
   157	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mount-submodule.sh exited 0 ($(grep -c 'Linked' "$LOG" || true) link lines)"
   158	
   159	# --- 3. Aleph off ---------------------------------------------------------------
   160	CFG="$DOWN/.loa.config.yaml"
   161	[[ -f "$CFG" ]] || : > "$CFG"
   162	if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   163	  run_step "aleph.enabled: false" yq -i '.aleph.enabled = false' "$CFG"
   164	else
   165	  printf '\naleph:\n  enabled: false\n' >> "$CFG"
   166	fi
   167	
   168	# --- 4. check-loa.sh ------------------------------------------------------------
   169	OUT="$WORK/check-loa.out"
   170	rc=0
   171	(cd "$DOWN" && CI=true bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh < /dev/null) > "$OUT" 2>&1 || rc=$?
   172	echo "----- check-loa.sh (downstream) -----"
   173	cat "$OUT"
   174	echo "----- end check-loa.sh (exit $rc) -----"
   175	
   176	tampered=$(grep -c 'Tampered: ' "$OUT" || true)
   177	missing=$(grep -c 'Missing: ' "$OUT" || true)
   178	not_mounted=$(sed -n 's/.*not-mounted: \([0-9][0-9]*\) path(s).*/\1/p' "$OUT")
   179	echo "fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=${tampered} Missing=${missing} not-mounted=${not_mounted:-0} check-loa-rc=${rc}"
   180	[[ $rc -eq 0 ]] && exit 0
   181	exit 1

lib_call() {  # lib_call <fn> <args…> — stdout appended to the evidence file; non-zero → infra
  local fn="$1" out rc=0; shift
  out="$("$fn" "$@" 2>>"$MOUNT_LOG")" || rc=$?
  [[ -n "$out" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$out" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || infra "$fn exited $rc (see meta/mount.log)"
  LIB_OUT="$out"
}

LIB_OUT=""
lib_call resolve_arm_toggles "$ARM" "$SUITE_FILE"
TOGGLES="$(printf '%s\n' "$LIB_OUT" | sed -n '/^[[:space:]]*[{]/,$p')"
if [[ -z "$TOGGLES" ]] || ! jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$TOGGLES"; then
  infra "resolve_arm_toggles printed no toggles object"
fi
TOGGLES="$(jq -c '.' <<<"$TOGGLES")"
# the toggles object is evidence, not a key=value line: drop it from the evidence file

mv "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE.tmp" "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
PLAN_JSON="$(plan_phases "$TOGGLES")"
LOA_MOUNT=true; [[ "$(jq -r '.loa_mount' <<<"$TOGGLES")" == false ]] && LOA_MOUNT=false
SINGLE_SESSION=false; [[ "$(jq -r '.context_resets' <<<"$TOGGLES")" == false ]] && SINGLE_SESSION=true
BASE_COMMIT="$(sgit rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'base_commit=%s\n' "$BASE_COMMIT" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"

if [[ "$LOA_MOUNT" == true ]]; then
  lib_call mount_prompt_surface "$WS" "$SOURCE_TREE" -
fi
lib_call apply_arm_toggles "$WS" "$TOGGLES" "$ARM"
if [[ "$LOA_MOUNT" == true ]]; then
  lib_call write_sandbox_grimoire "$WS" "$TASK_YAML" "$ARM" "$SPRINT"
  lib_call init_sandbox_beads "$WS" "$(jq -r '.title // .id' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
  mkdir -p "$WS/.run"
  [[ -e "$WS/.run/zone-guard-authorization.json" ]] && infra "sandbox carries .run/zone-guard-authorization.json"
  lib_call regen_sandbox_manifest "$WS"
